title: Senior Category Manager, Womenswear UK/EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>THE ROLE</strong></span></p> <p><strong>Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a <strong>Senior Category Manager, Women's UK/EU</strong><strong> </strong>to join our growing team. This role is suited to a data-driven product obsessed all-rounder. It supports the execution of merchandising strategy across selected womenswear categories, with responsibility for driving regional performance through strong product execution, trading, and customer insight. In this role, you will play a key part in scaling Quince’s value proposition in the UK & EU by delivering a compelling regional assortment, optimizing the customer experience, and partnering cross-functionally to bring high-quality products to market.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support end-to-end merchandising for selected womenswear categories in the UK & EU, including assortment execution, launches, and performance tracking</li> <li>Execute regional merchandising strategy in partnership with US Product Merchandising and international regional merchandising peers</li> <li>Contribute to product ideation, helping shape new product opportunities and business cases</li> <li>Work cross-functionally with Product and Regional Merchandising, Planning, Marketing, Technical Design, and Sourcing to deliver successful product launches—balancing inventory, go-to-market execution, and product quality (fit, sizing, and margin)</li> <li>Analyse trading performance (sales, returns, margin) and take ownership of actions to improve results</li> <li>Support pricing and assortment decisions for the region</li> <li>Own product catalogue management and administration, including product setup, data accuracy, and system maintenance</li> <li>Build site merchandising strategy, including PDP improvements roadmap and customer journey optimisations</li> <li>Monitor ratings, reviews, and returns to identify and support product quality improvements</li> <li>Manage regional product samples and merchandising assets</li> <li>Maintain merchandising reports, tools, trackers, and pricing files</li> <li>Take ownership of evaluating regional product compliance requirements and partner with Sourcing and Quality teams to execute</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications required: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Role is based in one of our UK/EU offices (London, Madrid, or Berlin), with 4 days per week in-office requirement</li> <li>8 years of retail merchandising or buying experience in womenswear categories, with demonstrated ownership of category performance</li> <li>E-commerce and/or DTC experience, with exposure to both startup and established (blue-chip) brands preferred</li> <li>Proven track record of progressing within an organization and demonstrating continuous growth in roles and responsibilities</li> <li>Strong product awareness, with a commercial mindset and attention to detail</li> <li>Product obsessed, with experience leveraging data tools and external sources to drive results</li> <li>Critical eye to anticipate customer needs (both the “science” and “art” of retail merchandising)</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, with experience using data to inform trading and merchandising decisions (e.g. sales, margin, return rates)</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in both executional and strategic support roles</li> <li>Experience working cross-functionally with teams such as Planning, Design, Sourcing, or Marketing</li> <li>Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills with particular ability to influence through concise written narrative</li> <li>Motivated by working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, where flexibility to stretch into or out of functional comfort zones is crucial for team success</li> <li>Adaptable and comfortable with ambiguity and change</li> <li>Bachelor’s Degree, preferred</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p data-renderer-start-pos="3319"><strong data-renderer-mark="true"><u description: Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben! The ideal candidate will be versatile and proficient in mechanical analysis, electronics packaging, computer-aided design (CAD), mechanical interfaces, thermal architecture, spacecraft propulsion, deployable and actuated structures, and environmental qualification of spacecraft antennas and payloads. You will be responsible for mechanical designs from concept through space flight including requirements definition, architecture trades and block diagrams, analysis, manufacturing, testing, qualification, and in-orbit support. The successful candidate will also present engineering design review materials to our customers and executive team, as well as participate in proposal-writing efforts. As such, excellent written and verbal communication skills are required. JOB REQUIREMENTS AND MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor of Science (BS) in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering from an accredited university or institution Minimum of 5 years of experience in space antenna and payload mechanical engineering to include electronics packaging, thermal, shock, vibration, stress dynamics, and cost. A Master's degree may count as two years of experience. Experience in conducting architectural trade studies including parametric and first-order cost and physical analysis Experience with professional mechanical and FEA CAD tools, such as Ansys Mechanical, SolidWorks Simulation, and Thermal Desktop Experience with CNC manufacturing and GD&T Experience with advanced aerospace manufacturing and materials including sandwich panels and carbon composites, OR experience with high-reliability deployment mechanisms for space applications (including deployment, HDRMs, power delivery, etc.). Proficiency in detailed mechanical design (3D CAD, drawings, etc.) Experience designing and manufacturing mechanisms and mechanical actuators Experience with EMI/EMC mitigation techniques Familiarity with satellite thermal architectures including heat pipes, phase change materials, contact resistance, and surface finishes as well as fundamental understandings of orbital thermal control in a LEO environment. Familiarity with launch and LEO environments (thermal, shock, vibe, radiation, etc) Familiarity with design for test, manufacturability, assembly, and reliability Excellent written and verbal communication skills PREFERRED EXPERIENCE Python, C++, or other programming languages Experience with large, deployable antenna arrays which drive your vision for the next generation of on-orbit communications and sensor arrays. title: Security Engineer - Purple Team specialist H/F
description: Pioneer of online flash sales since 2001 and key player in European e-commerce, Veepee collaborates with over 7,000 brands to offer highly discounted products available for a limited time. Operating across various sectors, including fashion, home, wine, travel or beauty... Veepee achieved a turnover of 3.3 billion euros incl. VAT in 2024 and employs 5,000 staff members across 10 countries. Organization and team The cybersecurity team includes Red/Purple/Blue teamers and risk & compliance oriented profiles, all working together to fix security weaknesses with innovative solutions, adapted to business needs. A Bug Bounty program, an authenticated program on our partner-facing platforms, an annual external Red Team engagement and recurring compliance assessments keep us honest, and our radar sharp. Our threat detection & incident response runs fully in-house, nothing is outsourced: you can touch everything, from detection engineering, case management and response, threat intelligence and the vulnerability lifecycle to the AI agents orchestrated on top of it all. Automation and AI are at the core of everything (who doesn't?): agents triage our alerts 24/7 so humans focus on what matters, an LLM pipeline audits our code, and every confirmed finding feeds a remediation loop with product teams. Responsibilities Attack Veepee's perimeter the way a real adversary would: red team, penetration tests (grey/black/white/AI box), Active Directory attack paths, phishing campaigns and the business web based processes themselves (member journeys, seller flows, payment chains), hunting for logic flaws no scanner will ever find. Put our risk register and threat intelligence to the test: take a stated risk or an emerging threat and confirm it, or refute it, with a working attack scenario. Qualify what comes in from the outside: Bug Bounty reports (public and authenticated programs) and alerts escalated by our RAG agents during the cyber-watching rotation. Convert every confirmed attack path into something that runs without you: a detection rule, a hunting query, an automated control. If a bot can do it, we automate it. Build and improve the team's tooling: AI-assisted code audit, password auditing, secret hunting, attack-surface monitoring. Carry your findings through to remediation: explain the impact to product and infra teams, propose the fix, track it through our vulnerability-management lifecycle, and re-attack to prove it's closed. Share your discoveries with technical and business teams and spread security culture in accordance with day-to-day constraints. Required skills The most important thing is motivation! Naturally curious profiles who enjoy proving or disproving that an attack works, and who don't consider the job done until it's fixed. Solid offensive skills: web and API penetration testing (OWASP), Active Directory attack techniques, and a taste for business-logic abuse beyond the technical stack. Investigation fundamentals: comfortable digging through EDR, logs and network data to reach a verdict, and turning attacker behavior into detection logic or solid on the offensive side with a strong will to grow there. Scripting and automation (Python, Bash, PowerShell); interest in AI-assisted security tooling (LLM-based code audit, agentic workflows) is a strong plus. You document what you do and make it reproducible. Strong communication skills: you can convince a product team to fix something they didn't want to hear about. Experience: ~3–5 years in offensive security, detection engineering or a mixed red/blue role. Language: French and professional English. ✅ BENEFITS Variable bonus The dynamic and creative environment within international teams The variety of self-education courses on our e-learning platform Participation in meetups and conferences locally and internationally Flexible Office with up to 2 days at home Health insurance ⚙️ RECRUITMENT PROCESS 1️⃣ 30-minute HR Screen with a Veepee Recruiter 2️⃣ Technical and operational exchange with the team 3️⃣ Last Interview with Head of cybersecurity We are convinced that it is up to you to define the way you work, to develop yourself, and to progress. title: Senior Product Builder - Talent Pool
description: <div class="content-intro"><div>Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.</div> <div> </div> <div>Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.</div> <div> </div> <div><strong>Our vision:  </strong>A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. </div> <div> </div></div><h3><strong>About the Role:</strong></h3> <p>You'll help build the very AI-powered platform you use every day, with real autonomy over the features you ship. Wrike is opening a new talent track for builders- senior engineers who take a feature from a rough idea to a production system on their own, and who use AI as a genuine multiplier rather than a buzzword. This isn’t a backfill for an existing seat. It’s a newly created role for someone who already operates autonomously and wants to keep doing that inside a company with real scale, real users, and daily production deployments. You take a high-level idea, figure out what actually needs to be built by talking to the right people, and ship it end-to-end: backend logic, frontend touches where needed, automated and manual testing, infra, and the dozen adjacent things a real feature needs. You read the existing codebase with judgment- reusing what’s solid, rebuilding what isn’t, and refusing to leave tech debt for the next person.</p> <p>AI is not optional here. You’re expected to work AI-native: using it daily to move faster, and knowing when to push back when it suggests something that doesn’t hold up. If you’ve written your own automation, scripts, or internal tooling to remove friction from your own workflow, that’s exactly the instinct we’re hiring for.</p> <h3><strong>Your Impact:<br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Take ambiguous, high-level product ideas and turn them into a concrete technical plan- by asking the right people the right questions, not waiting for a fully written spec</li> <li>Designed, built, and shipped end-to-end features across the full stack- including a Java/Spring backend, REST APIs, data layer, testing, infrastructure touches, and rollout- while utilizing modern frontend technologies like TypeScript, React 19, Microfrontends, and Module Federation, alongside legacy Dart components.</li> <li>Navigate a real, living codebase- deciding what to reuse, what to rebuild, and holding the line against unnecessary tech debt</li> <li>Think in systems: anticipate second-order effects before they become incidents</li> <li>Make technical and product tradeoff calls yourself, manage the risk, and push things over the finish line</li> <li>Use AI tools (Cursor, Claude/Codex, our internal AI portal and MCP) as a daily part of how you build- including writing your own automations and skills where they save real time</li> <li>Challenge AI output and product asks alike when they don’t hold up- critical thinking is part of the job, not a side skill</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your Qualifications:<br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strong full-stack engineering experience, with deep comfort in Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, and SQL, TypeScript, React 19</li> <li>A track record of owning features or systems end-to-end, not just executing a fully-specified ticket</li> <li>Experience navigating and improving an existing, non-trivial codebase- this isn’t a greenfield role</li> <li>Advanced, hands-on use of AI coding tools as part of your daily workflow- you’re past the learning curve already</li> <li>Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the outcome, good or bad</li> <li>Backgrounds we tend to see succeed here: technical founders, early engineers at startups who built the first version, small-company CTOs/Heads of Engineering, or senior engineers with active, recent open-source or side-project work</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Our Stack:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Java (21), Spring, REST APIs, SQL</li> <li>TypeScript, React 19, Redux, Dart</li> <li>PostgreSQL, Redis, RabbitMQ</li> <li>Unit/integration testing, Java web stack</li> <li>AI tooling: Cursor, Claude/Codex, Zencoder, internal AI portal, internal MCP</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Benefits & Perks:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>6 weeks of paid vacation + 5 RTT Recovery Days + Seniority Leave</li> <li>Parental Leave: 16 Weeks Maternity / 4 Weeks Paternity + Reserved Daycare Spot</li> <li>Health Insurance - Competitive Coverage - for employees + dependents</li> <li>Hybrid Work – Flexible hybrid working model with a monthly home office allowance of €20 (hybrid) or €50 (fully remote).</li> <li>Public transportation: Coverage of 75% of subscription fee / Sustainable mobility package 200€/year</li> <li>CSE Specific Benefits i.e. vacation vouchers, negotiated fees etc.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Interested in joining Wrike when the right opportunity opens up? Apply to our Senior Builder today. We’ll reach out as soon as a suitable role becomes available, or simply to arrange a Meet & Greet call.</strong></p> <p>Your recruitment buddy will be <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/aleksandar-chernev-479785214/">Alexander Chernev</a>, Senior Recruiter.<br><br></p> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">#LI-AC1</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>Who Is Wrike and Our Culture</strong></h3> <div>We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.</div> <div> </div> <div> <div><strong>Hybrid work mode</strong></div> <div><br> <div> <div>Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.</div> <div> </div> <div>While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.</div> </div> </div> </div> <h4><strong>Our persona </strong></h4> <div><strong>💡  Smart:</strong> We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.</div> <div><strong>💚  Dedicated: </strong>We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!</div> <div><strong>🤗  Approachable:</strong> We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. </div> <h4><strong>Our culture and Values </strong></h4> <p><strong>🤩 Customer-Focused</strong></p> <p><strong>We care about our customers. </strong>We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.</p> <p><strong>🤝 Collaborative</strong></p> <p><strong>We work as one and win together, </strong>each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Your responsibilities include: Centrally identifying, qualifying and prioritising relevant tenders and commercial opportunities; Organising and facilitating Go/No-Go decisions and according to the required approval process; Developing and safeguarding the bid strategy; Translating it into a clear plan and structured tender process; Independently leading multidisciplinary bid teams consisting of partners, managers, consultants, subject matter experts and in some cases external stakeholders; Managing timelines, progress, compliance and quality throughout the entire bid process; Organising reviews and critically assessing contributions before submission; Safeguarding legal and procedural requirements, particularly for European public tenders; Reporting on the tender pipeline, results and performance to the CRO; Evaluating completed bids and systematically translating lessons learned into improvements; Further developing governance, processes, tooling, knowledge management and reporting within the Tender Desk; Using data, technology and AI to make the bid process smarter, more efficient and more effective; Training and coaching colleagues who contribute to bids and helping to increase bid management maturity across the organisation; In case of emergency, it is important to also be able to write tenders yourself. As Bid Manager, you ensure that the overall process works: that the right people contribute, deadlines are met, decisions are made and strategy, quality and content come together. You are a Bid Manager, not a Bid Writer That distinction is important. At Valcon, consultants, partners and subject-matter experts provide the content and contribute to the actual writing of bids. Some colleagues will be specifically trained to participate regularly in tender processes, while others may have limited experience with public tenders. Your role is not to take over their writing. Instead, you ensure the team understands what is required, why it matters and when it needs to be delivered. You are therefore a project manager, strategist, quality gatekeeper and challenger at the same time. You are comfortable challenging an experienced consultant or partner when their contribution is not yet strong enough. You ask the right questions, keep the team focused on the agreed strategy and know how to create momentum without relying on formal authority. Strong stakeholder management is therefore essential. You need to be able to lead complex projects and influence senior stakeholders, partners and consultants across the organisation. Building the Tender Desk In addition to managing individual bids, you will have another important responsibility: further professionalising Tender Management within Valcon. A foundation is being created, but the way of working is still developing. This means you are not stepping into a fully established function where everything has already been defined. Instead, you will have the opportunity to further shape the processes, standards, governance, tooling and knowledge-sharing structure behind successful tender management. A modern approach to Bid Management is essential. Valcon aims to integrate data and AI into the bid process and is looking for someone who actively embraces these developments. You understand how technology can support opportunity identification, knowledge management, collaboration, quality and efficiency, and you are keen to explore how AI can become an integral part of the bid management process. What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. What do you bring to the table? You are an experienced bid or tender management professional who is ready for a role in which strategy, leadership and coordination carry more weight than writing proposals yourself. Ideally, you bring: A demonstrable track record of contributing to successful bids and winning significant opportunities. Significant experience in Bid Management and/or Tender Management within a complex professional environment; Strong project management skills, with the ability to create structure, organise decision-making and manage multiple workstreams and deadlines; Strong senior stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without formal authority; The ability to assess tenders and commercial opportunities from a strategic and commercial perspective; Experience within consulting, professional services or another knowledge-intensive environment is a strong advantage; Affinity with data, AI and modern bid management tooling; Experience coaching colleagues and helping teams adopt new ways of working; Who are you? You have the seniority and confidence to take the lead while still knowing how to bring people with you. You can move comfortably between strategic discussions and operational delivery and thrive in an environment with senior professionals who each bring their own expertise, priorities and perspectives to a bid. You are analytical and commercially minded, but also pragmatic. You ask challenging questions, make decisions when needed and are comfortable questioning whether the quality of a tender is genuinely good enough. At the same time, you enjoy building and developing: teams, processes and a Bid Management capability that is still evolving. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment? And do our core values - Together, Joy, Curious, Can do, and Integrity - resonate with you? Our recruitment team would be happy to hear from you! Please apply directly or get in touch with our recruitment team ----- to schedule a coffee meeting at our office first. title: Physician Assistant of Verpleegkundig Specialist
description: Wat ga je doen? Bij Cardiologie Centra Nederland, locatie Dokkum draai je zelfstandig spreekuur en ben je medisch inhoudelijk verantwoordelijk voor je eigen patiëntenpopulatie. Je stelt zelfstandig diagnose- en behandelplannen op, verricht risicostratificatie en begeleidt patiënten met uiteenlopende, complexe cardiologische beelden, zoals: Pijn op de borst (angina pectoris) en ischemische hartziekten; Hartritmestoornissen (o.a. atriumfibrilleren); Hartfalen, hypertensie en hypercholesterolemie; Hartkleplijden. Je combineert medisch-technische zorg met leefstijlgeneeskunde en langdurige opvolging. Waar nodig spar je op gelijkwaardige basis met de aanwezige cardiologen; de lijnen zijn bij ons kort en de sfeer is collegiaal. En omdat de inzet van een PA of VS bij onze locatie in Dokkum nieuw is, bieden we een kans: jij bouwt actief mee aan de vormgeving van deze rol en de polikliniek. Jouw visie, klinische blik en initiatief zijn hierin leidend. De locatie in Dokkum is gevestigd binnen het Sionsberg Netwerk Ziekenhuis. Je komt te werken in een toegankelijk en informeel team, waarin we echt voor elkaar klaarstaan. Bovendien biedt het werken in Dokkum rust en ruimte: gratis parkeren voor de deur, geen files en een prachtige omgeving. Bij CCN denken we mee over jouw ontwikkeling. Mocht jij jouw werk bijvoorbeeld op de cardiologie willen afwisselen met ervaring binnen bijvoorbeeld de traumatologie. We zijn een organisatie van zelfstandige behandelcentra voor hart- en vaatziekten die zich onderscheidt door poliklinische zorg perfect af te stemmen op de behoeften van de patiënt en de verwijzer. We geloven in de kracht van complete zorg onder één dak. Onze patiënten kunnen dicht bij huis terecht voor de meest hoogwaardige cardiologische zorg, en jij speelt daarin een belangrijke rol. We werken met geavanceerde hartritme-analyses (holtermonitoring), begeleiden patiënten op afstand via ons innovatieve e-health programma Hartwacht, en voeren poliklinisch elektrische cardioversies (ECV’s) uit. Met een eigen PM-technicus én een eigen spoedpolikliniek in huis is de dynamiek hoog. Daarnaast beschikken we binnenkort over onze eigen CT coronairen. Met deze modernste apparatuur brengen we lokaal, snel en non-invasief de kransslagaders in beeld, een fantastische kwaliteitsimpuls voor jouw diagnostische werk. Wie ben jij? Je hebt de Master Physician Assistant (MPA) óf Master Advanced Nursing Practice (MANP) afgerond en beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie; Je hebt aantoonbare klinische ervaring binnen de cardiologie (of een zeer sterke affiniteit om je hier in te verdiepen); Je bent communicatief sterk, werkt graag autonoom en zoekt de samenwerking op. De CAO zorgt voor een aantrekkelijk pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden. We willen het beste voor jou, het team en de patiënt. Wij bieden je onder andere het volgende: Een salaris tussen €5.295,- tot €7.901,- conform FWG 65 (cao ZKN) o.b.v. 40 uur per week. We schalen je in op basis van jouw ervaring; Vakantiegeld (8,33%), een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en deelname aan de pensioenregeling bij PFZW; Een jaarcontract voor 16-32 uur per week, met duidelijke intentie op een volgend contract voor onbepaalde tijd; Een gezonde werk-privébalans: wij bieden uitsluitend regelmaat. Je draait dus géén diensten in de weekenden of avond/nacht; 160 uur vakantieverlof en 72 PLB-uren o.b.v. een fulltime dienstverband; Reiskostenvergoeding van €0,23/km (er zijn parkeermogelijkheden bij deze locatie) of een NS business card voor woon-werkverkeer; Vakinhoudelijke en professionele ontwikkeling met onze interne klinische lessen en andere opleidingsmogelijkheden. We denken hierbij graag met je mee wat bij jou past; Extra secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals deelname aan onze fietsregeling, zodat je met belastingvoordeel een nieuwe fiets kan kopen. title: Werkvoorbereider

title: Triage audicien - Beek, Limburg
description: Bouw mee aan hoogwaardige hoorzorg binnen een zelfstandige optiekwinkel Ben jij audicien en wil je méér dan alleen hoortoestellen aanpassen? Zoek je een plek waar je de tijd krijgt voor je klant, kwaliteit vooropstaat en je tegelijkertijd de ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan een succesvolle audiotak? Dan is dit misschien wel jouw volgende stap. Premium hoorzorg, zoals het bedoeld is Binnen onze zelfstandige optiekwinkels staat persoonlijke aandacht centraal. Onze klanten kennen ons vanwege onze deskundigheid, kwaliteit en service. Diezelfde benadering willen we verder uitbouwen binnen horen. Daarom zoeken we een audicien die samen met ons wil bouwen aan een sterke audiotak. Afhankelijk van de situatie gaat het om het verder ontwikkelen van een bestaande klantenkring of het opbouwen van een nieuwe activiteit binnen een winkel waar al een vertrouwde klantenbasis aanwezig is. Je krijgt daarbij de ruimte om je vak uit te oefenen zoals jij vindt dat goede hoorzorg hoort te zijn: met tijd voor de klant, persoonlijke aandacht en premium hooroplossingen. Wat maakt deze functie anders? Je werkt in een professionele, persoonlijke omgeving waar niet de snelle verkoop, maar de beste oplossing voor de klant centraal staat. Je kunt rekenen op: · Premium hooroplossingen · Ruim voldoende tijd en aandacht voor iedere klant · Een bestaand klantenbestand vanuit de optiek · Warme leads via onze partner Audibene · Professionele ondersteuning en coaching vanuit de organisatie · Ruimte voor jouw ideeën en vakmanschap · De kans om daadwerkelijk mee te bouwen aan de audiotak · Dagen en uren in overleg, met aandacht voor een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé Voor wie is dit een mooie stap? Misschien werk je nu bij een grotere keten en zoek je meer persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en betrokkenheid. Of je bent toe aan een omgeving waarin je niet alleen audicien bent, maar ook kunt meedenken over hoe we de beste hoorzorg voor onze klanten organiseren. Ruime ervaring is voor ons niet het belangrijkste. Veel belangrijker is dat je passie hebt voor horen én voor mensen. Je bent iemand die kwaliteit belangrijk vindt, graag persoonlijk contact heeft met klanten en energie krijgt van samen iets moois opbouwen. Je wilt onderdeel zijn van een professioneel en kundig team, maar vindt het tegelijkertijd leuk om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen voor je eigen vakgebied. Wat bieden wij jou? Een zelfstandige functie met veel ruimte voor vakmanschap en persoonlijke aandacht, maar mét een professioneel team en organisatie achter je. Geen omgeving waarin iedere minuut wordt gestuurd door targets en agenda’s, maar een plek waar we geloven dat tevreden klanten en goede hoorzorg de basis zijn voor duurzaam succes. En minstens zo belangrijk: werk moet passen bij je leven. Daarom bespreken we graag samen welke dagen en uren het beste aansluiten. Of je nu een aantal dagen per week wilt werken of juist een volgende stap zoekt met meer verantwoordelijkheid: we kijken vooral naar wat bij elkaar past. Zin om samen iets moois op te bouwen? Ben jij audicien en spreekt de combinatie van kwaliteit, persoonlijke aandacht, vrijheid en bouwen je aan? Dan maken we graag kennis met je. title: Adviseur Loopbaan en Mobilteit Zuid NL
description: Als je goed zorgt voor je mensen, zorgen zij goed voor jou. Deze overtuiging van de oprichter van ADG Dienstengroep vormt de basis van Koersmakers. Koersmakers is een nieuw bedrijf dat werkt aan duurzame inzetbaarheid voor vakmensen, zodat zij maximale regie krijgen over het (werkende) leven. Om dit goed in de praktijk te brengen zijn we op zoek naar een adviseur in de regio Zuid Nederland Omschrijving van het team Koersmakers is een jong, maar groeiend team van 9 collega’s. Zwaantje ondersteunt hen in de dagelijkse operatie en Sterre is kwartiermaker en eindverantwoordelijk voor Koersmakers. Taken Wat ga je doen? Hierbij houd je rekening met de actuele regels tot Wet Verbetering Poortwachter en de verzuimcyclus van het UWV. Daarnaast ondersteun je de leidinggevenden van de verschillende ADG bedrijven hoe zij samen met hen de regie van vakmensen op het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk kunnen brengen. Ze vinden het geen probleem als je geen tot weinig ervaring hebt met het gebruik van onze testen. Vakmensen die werk doen wat vaak niet gezien wordt, juist als het écht goed gedaan wordt. Schoonmaakmedewerkers, onderhoudsmonteurs, hospitality professionals, BOA’s en zorgmedewerkers. Zij houden Nederland draaiend. Zij doen het voor hén. Jij zorgt dat de uitvoering van hun dienstverlening (in geval van Spoor 2 re-integratie) voldoet aan de eisen die de verzuimcyclus en de Wet Verbetering Poortwachter stelt. Je schakelt gemakkelijk met verschillende gesprekspartners en vertaalt doelen naar concrete stappen, ook wanneer de situatie nog niet volledig duidelijk is Je werkt gericht toe naar (nieuwe) mogelijkheden voor vakmensen om (weer) inzetbaar te worden en blijven. Je vertaalt doelen en mogelijkheden in concrete afspraken en houdt jezelf, medewerkers en leidinggevenden aan deze afspraken. Jij blijft je, ook bij weerstand of uitdagingen, inspannen om de inzetbaarheid van vakmensen te vergroten of behouden. Je werkt precies en zorgvuldig en signaleert bij onvolledigheden en afwijkingen in de begeleiding of rapportages. Hierbij schroom je niet om te benoemen wat je ziet en hoort, durf je kritische vragen te stellen, altijd met het doel om tot oplossingen en mogelijkheden voor inzetbaarheid te komen en altijd met respect voor de ander. Opleidingsmogelijkheden, denk bijvoorbeeld aan: o De predictive index practitioner o Of een andere opleiding die bijdraagt aan de doelstelling van Koersmakers: regie over het (werkende) leven naar de praktijk brengen. Een fijne werkplek in Houten of bij een van onze ADG zusjes. Mogelijkheid om thuis te werken. De kans om echt impact te maken en mee te bouwen aan een nieuw bedrijf Over Koersmakers Koersmakers is een startup van ADG. Een Twents familiebedrijf met ruim 11.000 collega’s dat groot is geworden met en dankzij hun vakmensen op de werkvloer. ADG zet zich in voor vakmensen met waardering en ondersteuning. Bij Koersmakers geloven ze in gelijke kansen voor iedereen en in een open organisatie waar iedereen zich prettig voelt. Zij willen dan ook een diverse en inclusieve werkgever zijn. Inclusie zorgt ervoor dat werknemers, ongeacht hun achtergrond, overtuigingen, voorkeuren etc, zich gewaardeerd, gerespecteerd en betrokken voelen. Koersmakers gelooft dat dit leidt tot een creatievere en productievere werksfeer, waar innovatieve ideeën kunnen bloeien, betere besluiten worden genomen en talenten volledig tot hun recht kunnen komen. title: Marketing & Content Intern (Haarlem)
description: Six restaurants. Six dishes. One afternoon, every dish with a pairing to match. An introduction to a city's food scene, and to the people shaping it. We have been making those introductions in the Netherlands as WijnSpijs since 2013. Table6 carries the same standards into the UK and Germany. The Netherlands is where we started and it is still the market we know best. Keeping it that way takes a steady stream of content: Dutch restaurants and creators to find and contact, footage and photography to collect and label, stories filmed on event days, posts prepared and checked after they go out. We are looking for a Marketing & Content Intern to work on all of it with us. The briefs, templates and guidelines already exist, so you are never starting from a blank page. You will use them from week one and take on more of the work yourself as you go. Most of what you do will be in Dutch. You will report to our Marketing Lead. The internship is hybrid, with agreed office days in Haarlem. Tasks Research restaurants, creators, photographers and videographers, and build shortlists against the criteria the marketing team gives you. Contact them, ask for footage, and follow up until it arrives. Come to selected events, including some Sundays, and film dishes, pairings, guest moments and the walk between restaurants to a short brief. Upload, name and label everything in Notion and Google Drive, so an editor can find it without asking you. Watch what our restaurant partners post, respond where it makes sense, and flag anything the marketing team should see. Prepare approved posts for scheduling, with captions, tags, links and locations, and check afterwards that they went out properly. In your first weeks you and your Marketing Lead agree what you want out of the internship and what you will own by the end of it. Requirements Fluent Dutch and strong English, written and spoken. Enrolled in a relevant study, and available full time for at least four months. Organised and accurate, with several requests and deadlines running at once. Comfortable writing to restaurants and creators yourself, and confident enough to ask when something falls outside the guidelines. At home on social platforms, and comfortable with Google Drive and simple spreadsheets. Available for selected Sunday events. They are always planned in advance. Nice to have, not essential Filming or editing for social; Canva, Notion or Meta Business Suite. Experience in a customer-facing job in hospitality or retail. A real interest in food and restaurants counts for more with us than a perfect CV. If you recognise yourself in most of the above, apply. Benefits A monthly internship allowance Hybrid, with agreed office days Lunch with the team A close view of how content gets made across three markets, from the brief through sourcing, capture, approval and publishing A seat at the restaurants on our lineups. Knowing what a good afternoon feels like is part of the job Sounds like your kind of work? Please apply with your CV and a cover letter, both in English. title: Project Manager - Managed Services

CBRE wordt wereldwijd erkend als een van de meest bewonderde en ethische bedrijven in haar sector en staat bekend om haar focus op innovatie, duurzaamheid en talentontwikkeling. Taken WAT GA JE DOEN? Van complete kantoorinrichtingen en fit-outs tot kritische technische upgrades en de realisatie van serverruimtes: jij zorgt ervoor dat projecten veilig, op tijd, binnen budget én naar volle tevredenheid van de klant worden opgeleverd. title: Production Planner
description: At Harvey Performance Company, we're more than a team; we're a community. Our thriving, dynamic, and rapidly expanding organization values community, celebrates success, and fosters personal and professional growth opportunities. Taken The opportunity Harvey Performance Company manufactures consumable precision cutting tools for industrial customers. We are seeking an experienced Production Planner to own production scheduling and material planning across our manufacturing operations. This role is responsible for translating demand forecasts and customer orders into achievable production schedules, ensuring material and capacity availability through disciplined use of SAP/Epicor ERP and Material Requirements Planning (MRP), and driving on-time delivery in a fast-paced, high-volume parts production environment In this role, you will be responsible for Develop, publish, and maintain detailed production schedules across manufacturing cells/lines to meet customer demand, on-time delivery targets, and inventory objectives. Own and execute Material Requirements Planning (MRP) within SAP/Epicor ERP, reviewing planned orders, exception messages, and net requirements to ensure timely material availability. Maintain accuracy of SAP planning master data, including planning parameters, lead times, lot sizes, safety stock levels, BOMs, routings, etc. Balance production capacity against demand forecasts and customer orders, adjusting schedules for a high-volume, high-mix precision manufacturing environment. Partner with Purchasing/Supply Chain to resolve material shortages, expedite critical components, and manage supplier lead times. Collaborate cross-functionally with Manufacturing, Quality, Engineering and Customer Service/Sales to resolve scheduling conflicts and support new product introductions. Monitor work-in-process (WIP), backlog, and finished goods inventory; identify and drive inventory optimization opportunities. Participate in and support the Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) process, providing planning input and capacity analysis. Track and report key planning KPIs (on-time delivery, schedule adherence, machine/labor utilization, inventory turns) to operations leadership. Identify, recommend, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to planning processes, systems, and data integrity (Lean/Six Sigma principles). Support daily production meetings and escalating schedule risks proactively. Vereisten You’ll bring: Minimum 5 years of production planning/scheduling experience in a high-volume parts manufacturing environment (required). Demonstrated hands-on experience with SAP ERP (PP and MM modules) and Epicor for production planning and material management (required). Highly competent in Material Requirements Planning (MRP) concepts, execution, and troubleshooting (required). Experience in precision manufacturing, cutting tools, metalworking, or a related consumable parts industry is strongly preferred. Strong analytical and Excel/data analysis skills; comfortable working with large datasets and planning reports. Excellent communication, organizational, and cross-functional collaboration skills. Proven ability to manage competing priorities and make sound decisions in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. Qualification in supply chain management, Business, Industrial Engineering and advantage or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Advanced knowledge of MRP logic, demand planning, and capacity planning principles. Strong problem-solving skills with a data-driven, root-cause approach. Ability to read and interpret BOMs, routings, and production schedules. Familiarity with Lean Manufacturing and continuous improvement methodologies. High attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy. Benefits What Harvey provides: Do you want to get the very best out of yourself? So do we! Klantgerichte instelling met een passie voor excellente ondersteuning van medewerkers. Sterke analytische vaardigheden en probleemoplossend vermogen. Vermogen om zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband te werken. Flexibel en comfortabel in een veranderende omgeving, met oog voor procesverbeteringen. Goede beheersing van Microsoft Office-applicaties, met name Outlook, Excel en PowerPoint. Talen Vloeiend Nederlands en Engels, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Benefits Wat bieden wij? Hybride werkmodel (3 dagen per week op kantoor in Uithoorn). Toegang tot QH University (meer dan 500 leerprogramma's) en uitgebreide ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden. Vergoeding voor zorgverzekering. Pensioenregeling. Regeling voor het kopen en verkopen van vakantiedagen. Exposure aan regionale HR-processen en samenwerking met diverse functies binnen EMEA. Een collegiale en internationale HR-werkomgeving. Well-being programma's, Colleague Resource Groups en andere aantrekkelijke DEI-initiatieven. Deze functie biedt een uitstekende mogelijkheid om je carrière binnen HR Operations verder te ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd een waardevolle bijdrage te leveren aan medewerkers en de organisatie. title: Intelligence Center X Engineering Manager - EMEA
description: Build and lead the team that brings Intelligence Center X to life for leading companies across the EMEA, through business-relevant enterprise agentic AI use cases. It connects a company's enterprise and operational data into an enterprise ontology, and uses machine learning and agentic AI to reason over it and act on it. Our customers are leaders in automotive, aerospace and defense, semiconductors and electronics, industrial machinery, pharma and financial services. How we engage with customers Beyond typical demos, we work forward-deployed with the customer — on relevant data, against their problem — and build a working agentic AI solution, grounded in an enterprise ontology. It is how we establish value with customers: where they see the use case come to life, and where we earn the right to move forward. Key Responsibilities The role As the ICX Engineering Manager for the EMEA, you build and lead the EMEA team of ICX Engineers — a presales FDE team that leads the ideation and creation of these engagements. They model a customer's domain as an enterprise ontology, build agents and machine learning that reason over it and act on it, and deliver working agentic applications that compel customers to invest in Intelligence Center X with Siemens. This is a formal people-management role, and a player-coach one. You: Lead by example — build customer solutions yourself, and set the bar for how the team builds them. Are a senior presence on key opportunities — with customers, and alongside sales leadership. Recruit and grow the team — hire strong engineers, and develop them. Evolve the global practice — work with global ICX leaders on how we engage with customers across every zone. You work alongside sales teams and strategic partners, and report to the EMEA Pre-Sales Leader. Another is building an agentic assistant that helps a pharma company make batch release decisions in hours rather than days. You are with a third customer's leadership team, shaping the next engagement. Your job is to make sure each one lands — and that what one engineer learns, the next one starts with. Through formal management or team-lead roles, you have led customer-facing FDE, presales, services or other technical teams. You are hands-on with agentic AI and ontology. You still build, and your team follows your example. You are entrepreneurial. You think in business value, and you are credible with customers and sales leadership alike. Skills and experience We look for experience or strong potential in the following areas. Leading technical teams — formal management or team-lead roles for customer-facing FDE, presales, services or other technical teams. Technical consulting leadership — leading client engagements and delivery teams in agentic AI, data and analytics at a consultancy or systems integrator. Recruiting and developing engineers — hiring strong people, coaching them and growing their careers. Senior customer presence — leading working sessions with technical and business stakeholders, including executives, on key opportunities. Data engineering and analytics — making sense of how a company's data is spread across its systems, bringing it together and modelling it. Modern data and AI platforms — experience working with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Google Cloud, AWS data lakes, Palantir or C3.ai. Agentic AI — designing agents and AI solutions grounded in enterprise data: LLMs, retrieval, tool use, MCP. Agentic development tools — Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot or similar, used to build quickly and well. Enterprise ontology — modelling a real business domain as an ontology or knowledge graph and putting it to work in an enterprise. Machine learning and data science — building models that solve real business problems, such as forecasting, anomaly detection or classification. Experience in our industries — manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, pharma, aerospace or financial services. Travel Some travel is expected, up to 25%. description: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e Senior Financial Accountant (comptable senior) capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables. Tes missions Gross margin et comptabilité énergie Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive Fiscalité énergie et TVA Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting Supervision et contrôle Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum) Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations Structuration et amélioration continue Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance Ce que l'on attend de toi De ton arrivée à 3 mois : Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre De 4 à 6 mois : Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation) Au-delà de 6 mois : Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre Ce poste est fait pour toi si Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni Ce qui fera la différence : Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart description: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. Tes missions Gross margin et comptabilité énergie Piloter la comptabilisation mensuelle des flux de marge brute (achats d’énergie, acheminement, ventes facturées et non facturées) et en produire une analyse critique : variations, écarts, leviers Fiabiliser le cut-off et les estimations de fin de mois (factures à établir, énergie livrée non facturée, provisions), en lien avec les équipes opérationnelles et facturation Justifier et documenter les comptes de ton périmètre, et traiter les anomalies jusqu’à leur résolution définitive Fiscalité énergie et TVA Établir, contrôler et déposer les déclarations de TVA (CA3) ainsi que les accises sur l’électricité et le gaz naturel et la CTA Établir les déclarations d’échanges de biens (EMEBI) sur les flux intra-UE Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur les questions fiscales du périmètre : analyser les cas nouveaux (offres commerciales, programmes de fidélité, nouveaux produits), formaliser une position et la challenger avec nos conseils externes Contribuer à la mise en conformité avec la réforme de la facturation électronique et du e-reporting Supervision et contrôle Superviser et contrôler les opérations de la comptabilité fournisseurs, et contribuer à l’amélioration de la chaîne d’automatisation (NetSuite, Rossum) Être l’interlocuteur·trice des commissaires aux comptes et des auditeurs sur ton périmètre : préparation des justificatifs, réponses aux demandes, suivi des recommandations Structuration et amélioration continue Identifier les points de friction dans les clôtures et les process, proposer des solutions et les mettre en œuvre Raccourcir et fiabiliser les clôtures mensuelles post-migration NetSuite Rédiger et maintenir la documentation des process et des contrôles Être moteur·trice dans le déploiement de l’IA et de l’automatisation au sein de la Finance Ce que l'on attend de toi De ton arrivée à 3 mois : Prendre en main NetSuite, Rossum et comprendre les flux entre l’ERP et les systèmes de facturation et de back-office Comprendre les mécanismes du marché de l’énergie et la construction de la gross margin Réaliser tes premières clôtures et déclarations en binôme, et livrer un premier diagnostic des fragilités de ton périmètre De 4 à 6 mois : Être pleinement autonome sur les clôtures, l’analyse de marge et l’ensemble des déclarations fiscales Être l’interlocuteur·trice de référence sur la fiscalité énergie, en interne comme vis-à-vis des CAC et conseils Avoir porté au moins une amélioration concrète et mesurable (process, contrôle, automatisation) Au-delà de 6 mois : Être force de proposition sur la feuille de route Finance et accompagner la montée en compétences de l’équipe sur ton périmètre Ce poste est fait pour toi si Tu es diplômé·e d’un DSCG, DCG, d’un master CCA ou équivalent, avec 4 à 7 ans d’expérience en comptabilité et fiscalité, idéalement avec un passage en cabinet d’audit ou d’expertise suivi d’une expérience en entreprise Tu as une solide maîtrise de la TVA et, idéalement, des accises énergétiques ; une expérience dans l’énergie, les utilities ou un secteur à fort volume de facturation est un vrai plus Tu es habitué·e aux clôtures mensuelles exigeantes et aux échanges avec les commissaires aux comptes Tu es très à l’aise avec la donnée : Excel avancé (TCD, XLOOKUP, Power Query), analyse de gros volumes ; une appétence pour l’automatisation et les outils d’IA est appréciée Tu as une bonne connaissance des ERP (NetSuite apprécié) et l'expérience d’un projet de migration ou de refonte de process souhaitée Tu maitrises le Français et l'Anglais professionnel (niveau B2-C1): tu échangeras régulièrement avec les équipes du groupe au Royaume-Uni Ce qui fera la différence : Tu es un·e vrai problem solver : face à un écart inexpliqué, tu ne te contentes pas de le corriger, tu remontes à la cause et tu fais en sorte qu’il ne se reproduise pas Tu es à l’aise dans un environnement en construction, où tout n’est pas encore documenté, et tu aimes structurer Tu es autonome, rigoureux·se et capable de prioriser dans un contexte qui bouge vite Tu sais vulgariser des sujets techniques et travailler avec des interlocuteurs non financiers (opérations, facturation, IT) Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailer chez nous ? Tu as vu le salaire ou la fourchette prévu·e pour ce poste mais tu aimerais en discuter ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment ! Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle. title: Account Executive (m/w/d) Legal Tech – DACH
description: Where Legal Leads. Drei Worte. Eine Überzeugung. Rechtsabteilungen sind nicht länger die Bremse im Unternehmen – sie sind der Hebel. Bei DiliTrust geben wir ihnen die Plattform, die diesem Anspruch gerecht wird: Verträge, Beteiligungen, Vorstandsarbeit und Legal AI – eine integrierte Suite für die gesamte Rechtsfunktion. Im Einsatz bei mehr als 3.000 Unternehmen in 64 Ländern, darunter führende Konzerne in Europa, Nordamerika und MEA. DACH ist unser nächster großer Wachstumsmarkt. Die Basis steht, jetzt skalieren wir . Du übernimmst ein eigenes Territory, baust deine Strategie eigenständig auf und entscheidest, wo du wachsen willst – unterstützt von einem Team aus Solution Consultants, BDR, Marketing und Customer Success, das in DACH bereits liefert. Der Legal-Tech-Markt ist über 16 Milliarden Dollar schwer und wächst jedes Jahr zweistellig. In zwei Jahren wirst du auf diesen Moment zurückblicken. Die Frage ist nur: Warst du dabei? Deine Rolle Du verantwortest ein eigenes Vertical in DACH, z.B. Financial Services, Energy, Manufacturing oder Pharma. Dein Fokus liegt auf Neukundengewinnung und gezieltem Cross-Sell in deinem bestehenden Portfolio. Du identifizierst und qualifizierst neue Opportunities, gemeinsam mit deinem BDR, über Anfragen, Marketing und gezielte Ansprache. Du arbeitest strukturiert, nicht aus dem Bauch. Du baust deinen Territory Plan auf, entwickelst Account Plans für deine Top-Targets und treibst gemeinsam mit deinem BDR fokussierte Pod Sprints in deinem Vertical. Deine Deals liegen typischerweise zwischen 50.000 € und 200.000 € Jahresvolumen. Sales-Cycles dauern 4–9 Monate. Pro Deal sprichst du mit 4–7 Entscheidern: Legal, IT, Einkauf, Finance, manchmal Vorstand. Du verkaufst eine Plattform, kein Einzelprodukt. Erstgespräche führen oft Legal Ops Manager oder General Counsel. Deals über mehrere Module sind bei uns die Regel. Du repräsentierst DiliTrust auf den wichtigen Branchen-Events wie z.B. Legal Revolution oder LegalTech. Du führst dort die Gespräche, die später zu Pipeline werden. Must-have 4+ Jahre Erfahrung im quotaverantwortlichen B2B-Software-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS-Umfeld. Erfahrung in komplexen Sales-Cycles mit mehreren Entscheidern aus Legal, IT, Finance oder Procurement. Methodisches Arbeiten: Du qualifizierst sauber (z. B. mit MEDDPICC) und führst belastbare Forecasts. Erfahrung im Verkauf an C-Level-Entscheider. Deutsch auf Muttersprachen-Niveau, sehr gutes Englisch – unsere Unternehmenssprache ist Englisch. Nice-to-have Erfahrung im Verkauf an Rechts-, Governance- oder Compliance-Funktionen. Du kennst die Welt regulierter Branchen - Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare oder Pharma. Du hast bereits eigenständig ein Territory aufgebaut – mit klarer Account-Strategie und nachhaltigem Pipeline-Aufbau. Du interessierst dich für KI im Unternehmenskontext und kannst Kunden den Unterschied zwischen Hype und echtem Mehrwert erklären. Was wir dir bieten Remote-First. Du arbeitest von zuhause oder in unseren Offices in München und Berlin - regelmäßige Team-Events bringen uns offline zusammen. Onboarding und Ramp-Up, das zu einem komplexen Produkt passt. Produkt, Branche und Methodik step by step - mit erfahrenen Teamkollegen, die dich auf Tempo bringen. Ehrliches Coaching, präsenter Sales Manager. Wir sind 7 Leute im DACH-Sales, keine Nummer in einer großen Maschine. Regelmäßige Einzelgespräche, gemeinsame Deal-Reviews. Wenn du gut bist, wird das gesehen. You will work on solutions ranging from clinical copilots and AI coaching tools to agricultural advisory chatbots and evaluation infrastructure. Collaborating with behavioral scientists, researchers, and embedded engineers, you will translate applied AI research into reliable, scalable products and reusable technical resources. Contribute to open-source AI evaluation infrastructure and tools that help nonprofit organizations assess and improve their AI products. Work closely with behavioral scientists, researchers, and field teams to identify recurring challenges and translate findings into reusable tools, frameworks, playbooks, and technical publications. Develop rigorous evaluation methods for AI systems, including appropriate datasets, evaluation criteria, and measurable performance improvements. Build and iterate on production-grade LLM applications and agentic systems, improving their reliability, usefulness, and performance for intended users. Monitor developments in applied AI research, assess relevant advances, and test promising approaches in practical settings. Mentor partner organization staff and help strengthen their internal technical capabilities and responsible AI practices. Contribute to workshops, seminars, and knowledge-sharing initiatives that communicate lessons and best practices from ongoing projects. Conduct site visits to understand operational challenges, observe how AI tools are used, and recommend technical improvements based on direct user needs. Take initiative in identifying problems, defining solutions, and driving projects through implementation and deployment. Requirements: The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning fundamentals with substantial hands-on experience delivering end-user AI products. You should be comfortable moving between research, experimentation, production engineering, and collaboration with nontechnical stakeholders, while maintaining a strong focus on practical impact. Strong foundations in mathematics, deep learning, large language models (LLMs), and modern AI systems. At least 4 years of hands-on machine learning engineering experience, including building, evaluating, and systematically improving at least one end-user-facing product powered by deep learning. Experience limited to integrating model APIs, building internal dashboards, or contributing solely to ML infrastructure does not meet this requirement. At least 1–2 years of experience building LLM-powered applications, including at least one production-grade agent beyond a proof of concept. Practical experience evaluating AI systems, with a strong understanding of dataset design, evaluation methodology, and performance measurement. Proficiency in Python and a willingness to remain deeply involved in hands-on implementation. Fluency in prompting and context engineering for agentic systems, including the ability to determine whether a problem requires improved prompting, a different model, better tools, or changes to the overall pipeline. Experience using AI coding agents to produce high-quality work, with the judgment and accountability to validate outputs and take responsibility for what you ship. Ability to read research papers, assess new ideas, and quickly test relevant approaches through practical experimentation. An experimental mindset, with the ability to reason carefully about data, models, and evaluation while making iterative, measurable progress. Strong first-principles thinking and the ability to design practical, scalable solutions. A user-focused approach that prioritizes whether a product works effectively for its intended audience. Proactive ownership, urgency, attention to detail, and the ability to carry projects through to completion without constant direction. Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to nonengineering audiences. A commitment to responsible AI development and technology that delivers meaningful social benefits. Bonus qualifications: Experience with multilingual natural language processing or low-resource languages, particularly Swahili, Hindi, and languages spoken across East Africa and South Asia. Previous work in global health, international development, or social-impact technology. Familiarity with behavioral science or AI applications designed to support behavior change. Experience with data annotation pipelines and LLM evaluation methodologies. Knowledge of AI safety, alignment, or responsible AI frameworks. Experience deploying models in production and working with cloud infrastructure such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure. Publications at leading AI conferences or substantial technical writing documenting engineering research and results. Remote work: Fully remote, asynchronous-first working environment. Flexible schedule: Work hours can accommodate your time zone, with no mandated core hours. International collaboration: Join a globally distributed team working across North America, Europe, East Africa, East Asia, and South Asia. Meaningful impact: Build AI applications addressing practical challenges in healthcare, agriculture, and other areas of international development. Here are the challenges to be tackled as an SRE : Define and build the infrastructure needed to answer our performance challenges, automate it, and make it scalable. Reporting to the CISO, you'll own the security roadmap for Pigment's product, infrastructure, and CI/CD environment, and you'll build much of it yourself. This is a hands-on role: expect to read code, threat model new services, reproduce and triage vulnerabilities, dig through infrastructure configuration and build the automation that closes gaps. You'll also set direction and bring product and engineering with you, but that influence comes from technical credibility and not process: the engineers you work with will take you seriously because you've been in the same code they have. The scope is broad: application security, infrastructure security, detection and response, and the assurance work that keeps our certifications standing. You won't be covering it alone. The security team is seven people and growing, with colleagues already owning compliance, governance and security operations, so this role can go deep on product and infrastructure and not be spread too thin across everything. Nobody arrives fluent in all of it: we're looking for real depth in several of these areas and the judgement to grow into the rest. Key responsibilities include: Product & Infrastructure Security Design - Design security features into the product itself and strengthen defence-in-depth across the platform. Threat model new services before they ship, and make the architectural calls that are expensive to reverse later. Security Review & Risk Assessment - Review code, architecture and configuration yourself, and be the person developers and PMs bring problems to early rather than late. Deliver solutions that balance risk against business benefit, and escalate the calls that genuinely need senior arbitration. Assurance & Testing - Run our assurance programme: internal code, architecture and configuration reviews, red team exercises, and the bug bounty. Own the relationship with third-party auditors, and measure the control KPIs that keep our certifications defensible. Vulnerability Management - Own vulnerabilities from detection through to verified fix: reproduce them, score and triage them, design or validate the mitigation, and confirm it actually worked. Improve the KPIs that tell you whether the process is holding. Detection Engineering - Build and improve our detection capability alongside the infrastructure and engineering teams: identify the signals worth collecting, write rules that catch real attacks without drowning us in noise, and build the response playbooks behind them. Incident Response - Lead security investigations into the production environment end to end, from first signal to root cause, across incidents and fraud. Flag the repetitive work worth automating and the detections worth building, and hand those to the security operations team. SDLC - Set the technical direction for how engineers at Pigment build securely: guidance, paved paths, and reviews that teach and not just gate. Contribute to company-wide awareness where it counts, but your primary audience is product, engineering and SRE. Example projects that would fall under your responsibilities (actual examples of recently completed or currently on the roadmap): Secure the design and development of our AI features, including the MCP Server and Modeler Agent: threat modelling, design reviews, working alongside the engineers building them, and security assessments. Work out where AI-assisted analysis actually belongs in our pipeline. AI-powered security reviews reason about a diff semantically rather than pattern-matching it, which is genuinely different from classic SAST - but it's not a drop-in replacement, and figuring out the split between AI review, traditional SAST and SCA is an open question we'd like you to answer with evidence rather than vendor claims. Migrate GitHub to managed identities: provisioning through Okta, retiring personal accounts and long-lived PATs, and moving CI to short-lived OIDC credentials instead of stored keys. Design agent identity for the MCP Server - delegated access tokens, token exchange, and making sure an agent acting for a user can never exceed what that user could do themselves. Push least privilege further across production and CI/CD. Better than it was, not where we want it. As a (Senior) Principal Mendix Consultant, you bring together strategic thinking, platform expertise and strong leadership. You’ll lead multidisciplinary project or DevOps teams with full end-to-end ownership – from uncovering client needs to delivering scalable, future-ready applications. You take the lead in workshops, architecture and design decisions, translating complex business challenges into impactful IT-solutions – ranging from mobile and workflow apps to data-driven and integrated platforms. Increasingly, you’ll work on solutions that leverage AI, smart automation and advanced integrations to unlock new business value. Beyond delivery, you’ll play a key role in shaping our Low-Code capability. You help scale teams, raise engineering standards, and contribute to strategy, talent development and internal best practices. As a technical lead, you’re also actively involved in pre-sales, shaping proposals and leading proof-of-concepts for new clients. Depending on your interests, you can further grow towards strategic client ownership, technical depth or mentoring responsibilities – always with the freedom to shape your own path. Among your responsibilities will be the following: Designing, developing and testing innovative Mendix solutions in an agile way. Tackling complex technical challenges and shaping long-term platform strategies. Coaching developers and consultants to grow their skills and confidence with the Mendix platform. Supporting pre-sales activities and helping shape client proposals and proof-of-concepts. Strengthening our Low-Code capability through improved standards, best practices and strategic team development. Requirements Experience: A completed Bachelor’s, Master’s or technical HBO degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, Econometrics, Mathematics or a related field. At least 4 years of working experience as Mendix specialist/application developer and Mendix Advanced Developer certification. Nice to have: Mendix Expert Developer Certification and/or a specialisation in a domain like UI/UX, Architecture or custom (react/java) development. Fluent in Dutch and English Located in The Netherlands Benefits What do we offer you? Personal development: a tailor-made growth path with training, courses, certification and mentoring by experienced colleagues. An innovative work environment: collaborate with a team of experts pushing boundaries in data, technology, and consulting. Immediate impact and responsibility: you’ll make a difference for our clients from day one and are entrusted with responsibilities that challenge you to bring the best out of yourself. Inspiring work culture: a supportive, flexible, and no-nonsense environment that fosters your growth and fully allows you to be yourself. Additionally, we offer: Competitive employment benefits, including bonuses and expense allowance. A company car or mobility budget. A workplace that prioritizes and respects your work-life balance (for example by offering you the option of taking a sabbatical or expand the amount of holidays per year). An affordable sports membership that allows you to participate in 50 different sports offered by over 10,000 partners. The opportunity to work remotely from abroad for 10 days per year. A vibrant community that organizes both professional and social events. Ready to apply? Has the above sparked your interest and are you ready to join our innovative and impactful environment?
