title: AI Solutions Engineer
description: Waarom deze rol bestaat De meeste AI-projecten halen productie nooit. Zes maanden verder, budget verdubbeld, scope gehalveerd, en wat er ligt is een presentatie in plaats van software die eindgebruikers omarmen. Wij doen het anders. Een werkende POC in zeven dagen, op echte data van de klant. Daarna in weken naar productie. Die belofte houdt alleen stand als de mensen die hem waarmaken scherp zijn. Met agentic coding tools zoals Claude Code en Codex komt er sneller iets werkends uit dan ooit. Daardoor verschuift het werk van bouwen naar regie voeren. De vraag achterhalen, de juiste oplossing ontwerpen, AI en engineering slim inzetten, en de kwaliteit bewaken. Daarom zoeken we iemand die tussen developer en consultant in zit. Technisch sterk genoeg om zelf te bouwen en te beoordelen of iets deugt, sterk genoeg aan de voorkant om de vraag achter de vraag te vinden, en verantwoordelijk tot het live staat en live blijft. AI schrijft bij ons veel. Verantwoordelijkheid kun je niet uitbesteden. Alles wat jouw naam draagt, heb je zelf gelezen, gecontroleerd en begrepen voordat het de deur uitgaat. Taken Er zijn twee manieren waarop onze klanten bij ons bouwen, en jij doet ze allebei. Wij bouwen Een klant stapt binnen met een proof of concept. Zeven dagen, een scherp gekaderde scope. Jij ownt die POC. Jij vraagt uit wat er echt nodig is, jij bepaalt wat er wel en niet in gaat, jij bouwt hem op hun echte data, en jij neemt de klant stap voor stap mee in de demo. Daarna bouw je het in weken uit tot MVP. Vanaf dat moment doe je het niet meer alleen. Je haalt je team erbij, neemt ze mee in wat het moet worden en bouwt samen verder. Vervolgens maak je het productieklaar, met auth, monitoring en CI/CD. Jij blijft er eigenaar van. De klant bouwt, wij borgen Bij een groeiend deel van onze klanten bouwt hun eigen team met Claude Code, Codex en Cursor. Wij reviewen elke pull request, tekenen elke release en zetten de productieomgeving op, volgens onze standaarden en zonder dat ze erop hoeven wachten. Daar is je rol anders. Je zit bij hun product owners, delivery lead en developers aan tafel, je kijkt kritisch mee met wat ze maken, en jij borgt dat het veilig en productiewaardig live komt. Je bouwt minder zelf en je beoordeelt meer. Dat vraagt dat je kunt uitleggen waarom iets niet deugt zonder dat iemand zich aangevallen voelt, en dat je ze in gewone taal meeneemt in hoe het wel hoort. Je hebt je eigen klantportfolio en bent hun aanspreekpunt binnen SevenLab. Je begeleidt discovery sessies en workshops om tot richting en prioriteiten te komen, en je schat in wat je zelf doet, wat je samen oppakt en wanneer een specialist moet aanhaken. Vereisten Must have meerdere jaren ervaring met het bouwen van webapplicaties of softwareproducten; je hebt zelf software naar productie gebracht die nu live draait en door klanten wordt gebruikt, en je kunt het laten zien; je kunt in een week in je eentje iets werkends neerzetten op echte data, en je weet wat je bewust buiten scope houdt om dat te halen; je hebt eerder in een rol gezeten waarin techniek en klantcontact samenkwamen, en je kunt een klantgesprek leiden en de vraag achter de vraag vinden; je bent kritisch op codekwaliteit, structuur, testbaarheid en onderhoudbaarheid, ook bij code die een AI-tool oplevert. Niets gaat langs jou zonder dat je het hebt getest en beoordeeld; je kunt iets veilig live zetten en live houden: deployment, monitoring, security, en weten wat je doet als het misgaat; je denkt in systemen. Kom je iets voor de derde keer tegen, dan los je het niet voor de derde keer op. Dan bouw je iets zodat het niet meer gebeurt; je zoekt het eerst zelf uit in de documentatie, de code en de logs. title: Adviseur Financiële Effecten
description: Wil jij je analytische vaardigheden inzetten voor beter overheidsbeleid en tegelijkertijd snel groeien in een dynamische adviesomgeving? In ons kleine, hechte team combineer je onderzoek, analyse en advies om beleid en regelgeving daadwerkelijk te verbeteren. Kortom: een rol waarin je je expertise kunt inzetten, je vaardigheden blijft ontwikkelen en tegelijkertijd impact maakt bij allerlei verschillende organisaties. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Platform  (f/m/d)
description: Staff Backend Engineer – Platform Join Apaleo and shape the future of hospitality tech Apaleo is the world's most open, API-first property management platform powering the next generation of hospitality operations. Its modular, AI-powered infrastructure lets hoteliers customise their tech stack, automate routine work and deliver seamless, personalised guest experiences, powered by best-in-class apps and autonomous AI agents that adapt to every stay. If you're driven by the idea of making hospitality smarter, more human and powered by cutting-edge technology, we'd love to hear from you. About the role You'll join our Platform team as an individual contributor working closely with our Principal Engineer, who leads Platform's technical direction. Platform owns infrastructure, developer experience and security foundations for the whole engineering org, so this is a high-ownership seat: you'll take on large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives and drive them from first analysis through to completion, with real autonomy over how you get there. We don't run a groomed backlog or sprint planning. We assign a big topic to someone who owns it end to end. If you thrive with structure handed to you, this isn't the role; if you love spotting the problem worth solving and driving it yourself, you'll fit right in. What you'll be up to Architecting and developing scalable, reliable and maintainable backend systems. Self-identifying and scoping problems and initiatives, not just executing assigned tickets: assessing impact, prioritisation and timing independently. Leading architectural decisions and design discussions with cross-team alignment. Driving large, ambiguous, cross-cutting initiatives end to end, including coordination with multiple stakeholders. Mentoring engineers and driving technical excellence. Building and maintaining internal tools and infrastructure (AWS, Terraform) that empower teams to deliver faster and more reliably. Owning observability, logging and operational excellence to keep the platform highly available. Participating in on-call rotations and stepping in as a reliable problem solver during incidents. Proactively spotting where AI and automation can drive technical improvement. Some of the challenges waiting for you Solving horizontal write-scaling for our database (we already scale reads horizontally). Modernising our CI/CD pipeline for faster, more reliable delivery. Migrating our infrastructure-as-code fully from CloudFormation to Terraform, including the ability to recreate an Apaleo environment from scratch. Extracting and reworking common services (like shared schedulers) to get us ready for our next scale level. What you'll bring to the team 8+ years of backend development experience, including several years in a staff-level or technical leadership role. Strong engineering fundamentals that transfer across languages and cloud platforms: we care more about how you think than which stack you've used. A track record of owning large technical initiatives from ambiguity through to completion, ideally on a platform or infrastructure team rather than a pure product team. Experience designing and scaling distributed systems in cloud-native environments (AWS preferred; strong Azure fundamentals with genuine enthusiasm for the switch work just as well). Comfortable working with containerised services and infrastructure-as-code (Docker, Terraform; CloudFormation exposure is relevant given our current stack). Confidence writing your own unit and integration tests: we don't have a dedicated QA function. Fluent English. Nice to have Direct experience with C# (.NET), PostgreSQL, AWS and ECS/Kubernetes: a great fit, though not a hard requirement if your fundamentals are strong. Experience setting up infrastructure-as-code from scratch and working with it day to day, ideally with Terraform, including migrating or consolidating from other IaC approaches (like CloudFormation). Experience with Kafka or other event-driven and streaming systems (Azure Service Bus experience is a good transferable equivalent). Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, ChatGPT, Amazon CodeWhisperer) and a genuine interest in AI-driven engineering improvement. Excellent collaboration and communication skills, particularly for introducing new technology, like AI tooling, to other teams. What we offer Culture and growth A diverse and international team: work alongside passionate professionals from over 20 nationalities. Growth and development: 360° feedback reviews, a dedicated learning budget and an evolving career framework. Autonomy and ownership: we empower you to take responsibility, make decisions and contribute directly in an environment built on trust and transparency. Shape the future of hospitality tech: your work drives real impact from day one, at a fast-growing scale-up. Competitive and fair compensation, guided by benchmarking data to ensure fairness across all roles and teams. Perks and lifestyle Flexible and remote work options: office, home or hybrid, based on what works for your role and team. A fully covered Deutschland Ticket for free public transport across Germany. Regular team dinners, company meetups, Oktoberfest celebrations, Christmas parties and other offsite events. 30 days of paid holiday to fully disconnect, recharge and return inspired. An EGYM Wellpass membership giving access to hundreds of gyms, fitness studios and wellness options. Where you'll work from This role is based in Munich, with hybrid working from our office there. We're also open to remote within Germany, or remote via an Employer of Record for candidates based outside in the EU/ Europe. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender identity or expression, sex, national origin, age, marital status, disability or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. With integrations across hundreds of apps through the Apaleo Store, we simplify operations, elevate the guest journey and drive revenue growth for our customers. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager - Fiscal (f/m/d) to help us make Apaleo compliant, fast, wherever we grow next. You'll own the delivery of features that keep our platform compliant across markets, working closely with a Senior Product Management Lead who sets the strategic direction for the wider fiscal and tax domain. What You'll Be Up To Owning the end to end delivery of one or two product crews within the fiscal and legal domain, for example invoicing or taxation. Turning roadmap priorities into clear, well scoped work your engineering team can execute against. Balancing planned roadmap delivery with the steady stream of regulatory and reactive work that comes with keeping Apaleo compliant in markets we've already launched. Writing clear specs, defining what done looks like and following through on impact analysis so nothing falls through the cracks. Working shoulder to shoulder with engineering as a technical partner. You'll get into the detail of our API-first architecture rather than handing off a ticket and waiting. Shielding your team from noise and distractions so they can focus on what matters, whilst keeping delivery predictable. Partnering with customer success, compliance and engineering stakeholders to understand what's needed and translate it into shippable work. Helping the team move faster on new country launches, contributing to our ambition of making Apaleo compliant in many more markets over the next few years. What You'll Bring to the Team At least 3 to 4 years' experience as a Product Manager, ideally in a fast moving startup or scale up environment. A strong execution mindset. You're energised by shipping, not just planning, and you take ownership of your product area without needing to be hand held. Comfort working with technical, API-first products. You can talk architecture with engineers, challenge their thinking and understand what you're shipping in real depth. Sharp prioritisation instincts. You know how to sequence work, say no to good ideas that aren't great ones, and keep a team focused day to day. A genuine curiosity for complex domains. You dig into the details rather than staying at the surface, and you're not afraid of a codebase with some history to it. Clear, confident communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. You'll get real autonomy and ownership, without unnecessary hierarchy in the way. A key role in a fast growing startup, right in the heart of Munich. Fair, transparent compensation with a clear peer review and career progression plan. Flexible working, with hours and remote options that depend on the role. Team events that are actually fun: cocktail nights, team dinners, meetups and our legendary Oktoberfest celebrations. 30 days of holiday to properly switch off and recharge. Free public transport in Munich. Your commute, covered. How You'll Make an Impact Joining Apaleo means more than taking on a role. title: Software Engineer II
description: <div> <div class="attachment-overlay preview"> <div id="viewer-container"> <div id="canvas-container"> <div id="viewer" class="pdfViewer"> <div class="page" data-page-number="1" data-loaded="true"> <div class="textLayer"> <div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>About Tripadvisor</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.</p> <p><strong>Tripadvisor Experiences Engineering</strong> is the team that builds and supports the <strong>world's leading marketplace for travel experiences</strong>. We believe that making memories is what travel is all about. And with 400,000+ travel experiences to explore—everything from simple tours to extreme adventures (and everything in between) —making memories that will last a lifetime has never been easier.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We’re looking for a<strong> product-focused Software Engineer II</strong> to join our fast-growing Experiences Engineering team. This is a full-stack role, leveraging <strong>Java, SQL, React, AWS and AI tools</strong>. It’s ideal for mid-level engineers who enjoy solving complex problems, shipping frequently, and working in a modern cloud environment. You’ll play a key role in building high-impact features that power millions of traveler experiences globally. </p> <p> </p> <p>We embrace flexibility in where and how work gets done and also value meaningful in-person moments to connect and collaborate. You can expect a <strong>remote-first working model</strong> with periodic in-person gatherings at your closest office for team connection, planning, or other key moments. This position is open to candidates based within a commutable distance (generally up to 1.5 hours) of one of our office hubs in<strong> </strong><strong>Oxford.</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What You’ll Do </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Drive Impact:</strong> Connect your engineering work directly to traveler value by owning features from design to deployment.</li> <li><strong>Shape the Product:</strong> Partner with product, design, and data teams to influence what we build, helping to define specifications and find the most efficient path to success.</li> <li><strong>Collaborate & Mentor: </strong>Review code, provide thoughtful feedback, and coach less experienced engineers to maintain a high bar for quality.</li> <li><strong>Innovate with AI: </strong>Use agentic AI as a daily partner to plan approaches, automate routine tasks, and focus your energy on solving more complex technical challenges.</li> <li><strong>Champion Operational Health: </strong>Take hands-on ownership of system reliability by building monitoring dashboards, managing alerts and support cases, and fixing underlying bugs to continuously improve service resilience and eliminate operational toil.</li> <li><strong>Build for Quality: </strong>Design and implement clean, maintainable solutions with a focus on performance, security, and automated testing.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Skills & Experience </strong></p> <p>We typically look for a minimum of 2-3 years’ experience, following a Bachelor’s degree or above in Comp Science or a related field.</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Full-Stack Mindset: </strong>Experience developing web apps, including proficiency in a modern backend language (e.g., Java, C#, Go, Python) and familiarity with relational databases.</li> <li><strong>Problem Solving: </strong>A strong grasp of computer science fundamentals (data structures, algorithms) and the ability to apply them to real-world distributed systems.</li> <li><strong>Data-Driven: </strong>A habit of using operational data and experiment results to validate that your changes had the intended effect.</li> <li><strong>AI Coding:</strong> you are fluent coding with either Cursor or Codex/Claude/Open Code. </li> <li><strong>Global Mindset: </strong>Ability to operate effectively within a global team, communicating clearly about progress and blockers.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>We don’t expect you to know everything on day one. However, we’re especially interested if you’ve had exposure to AWS, React, or NoSQL databases. More than any specific tool, we value curiosity and the ability to solve problems creatively. </p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>We value engineers from different technical backgrounds. You can complete our<strong> coding interview exercises</strong> in any language of your choice, but need to be open to working within the Java ecosystem when you join!</p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Competitive compensation packages</strong>, including base salary, annual bonus, and more.</li> <li><strong>“Work your way”</strong> with flexibility to suit your lifestyle. We take a remote-friendly approach to collaboration, with the option to join on-site as often as you’d like in select locations. </li> <li><strong>Flexible schedule</strong>. Work-life balance is ingrained in our culture by design. Trust and accountability make it work.</li> <li><strong>Donation matching</strong>. Give back? Give more! We match qualifying charitable donations annually.</li> <li><strong>Tuition assistance</strong>. Want to level up your career? We love to hear it! Receive annual support for qualified programs.</li> <li><strong>Lifestyle benefit</strong>. An annual benefit to spend on yourself. Use it on travel, wellness, or whatever suits you.</li> <li><strong>Travel perks</strong>. We believe that travel is employee development, so we provide discounts and more.</li> <li><strong>Employee assistance program</strong>. We’re here for you with resources and programs to help you through life’s challenges.</li> <li><strong>Health benefits</strong>. We offer great coverage and competitive premiums.</li> <li><strong>Generous referral scheme.</strong> Help us grow and be rewarded with generous awards for referring successful candidates.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Cultural Pillars:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Traveller first: </strong>We exist to create value for our customer, the traveler. We enable our suppliers and partners to unlock this value. Their collective behaviors and insights are what drives us. </li> <li><strong>Execution is our edge: </strong>We act fast, experiment, learn from failure, iterate, and improve the solutions of tomorrow across every aspect of our business. Our execution is agile, data-driven, prioritised, and built to scale. We assume no problem is someone else’s problem and finish what can be done today, knowing tomorrow will bring fresh challenges. </li> <li><strong>We succeed together: </strong>The best outcomes are driven by empathic, humble, and diverse subject matter experts working toward shared goals. We collaborate relentlessly, challenge assumptions, give actionable feedback, and set each other up for success through empowered teams with a clear charter. We transparently take ownership of our growth, individually and as a team. We celebrate the quality of our effort, our learnings, and our collective achievements.</li> </ul> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>Discover more in our <a href="https://medium.com/tripadvisor">Tech Blog</a>, for an inside look into some of our exciting and ground-breaking technical projects here at Tripadvisor Group.  </p> <p>Tripadvisor Group champions the unique identities, abilities, and experiences of all our people – employees, customers, and partners. This stems from our belief in the transformative power of travel, dining, and experiences to connect us and open doors to worlds very different from our own. Our <a href="http://www.purpose.tripadvisor.com/diversity">ED&I strategy </a>shapes how we approach our people, culture, business, and reputation. Tripadvisor Group strives to embed inclusion and belonging across all our brands. </p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <p>We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please make sure to reach out to your individual recruiter or our team at ----- <p>If you have any additional questions about careers at Tripadvisor you can email us at ----- We have all the answers!</p> <p> </p> <p>#LI-Hybrid </p> <p>#LI-SM1</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: AI Platform Engineer
description: <blockquote> <p>Great AI doesn’t start with a great model. It starts with a great platform.</p> </blockquote> <p>The success of an AI initiative is rarely determined by the model alone. More often, it depends on the quality of the platform underneath it.</p> <p>As a Platform Engineer in our central Data & AI team, you’ll build the foundations that let engineers develop, deploy and operate AI workloads safely and efficiently. You’ll work on the infrastructure, automation and platform capabilities that allow teams to innovate without compromising reliability, and you’ll bridge the gap between promising technology and production reality.</p> <p>Think Kubernetes platforms, deployment automation, observability, security and developer experience. Think AI workloads built around Large Language Models, retrieval systems, graph technologies and modern data platforms. Think creating an environment where engineers focus on solving problems rather than fighting infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What you will work on</strong></p> <ul> <li>Designing self-service platform capabilities using Kubernetes, Terraform and GitOps principles</li> <li>Operationalizing graph and vector databases, and enabling model serving workloads</li> <li>Improving the observability of AI systems running in production</li> <li>Integrating OpenAI or Anthropic-based services into our platform</li> <li>Operationalizing LangGraph workloads on Kubernetes</li> <li>Enabling GraphRAG architectures powered by Neo4j</li> <li>Designing deployment patterns so AI services meet the same standards as any other production workload</li> </ul> <p>You’ll spend less time tuning models and more time making sure AI capabilities can be trusted, operated and continuously improved. This role sits at the intersection of platform engineering, software engineering and AI.</p> <p>At Schuberg Philis we don’t believe in throwing solutions over the fence. The engineers building systems are responsible for running them too, and that ownership extends to AI just as much as every other technology we work with. Your impact won’t be measured by the number of clusters you manage, but by how much autonomy and confidence other engineers gain from the platform you’ve built.</p> <p><strong>We’d love to meet you if</strong></p> <ul> <li>You care deeply about building platforms that other engineers love to use, and you’re happiest when automation replaces repetitive work</li> <li>You have a strong background in Platform Engineering, SRE, infrastructure or distributed systems</li> <li>You have extensive experience building and operating Kubernetes-based and cloud-native environments, with infrastructure automation at scale</li> <li>You’ve built and operated production environments using tools such as Terraform, ArgoCD, GitHub Actions or similar</li> <li>You understand what it takes to operationalize AI workloads in production, and technologies such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Neo4j, GraphRAG, vector databases or LangGraph are familiar territory</li> <li>You believe observability, reliability and security belong in every design conversation</li> <li>You enjoy improving developer experience through automation and self-service</li> <li>You see the gap between a successful proof of concept and a production-ready system and immediately start figuring out how to close it</li> <li>You take ownership of the result</li> <li>You get satisfaction from enabling other engineers to move faster and safer</li> <li>You are currently based in the Netherlands. </li> </ul> <p>Questions? Please do not hesitate to contact Maggie: 0623757086</p> <p><em><strong>Only applications submitted through the website will be considered. Please note that we do not work with external recruitment agencies and we will not pay any fees for unrequested CV introductions. </strong></em></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>Everyone we work with and consider working with has a right to equal treatment. The hiring and appraisal process at Schuberg Philis is designed to be thorough and equitable, implementing fair payment, benefits, and opportunities across all demographics. </em><br><em> </em><br><em>It is our desire to be a company that brings together multiple nationalities, cultures, religions, genders, abilities, and talents within and across our teams. We welcome colleagues from diverse backgrounds to join Schuberg Philis and actively support diversity and inclusion in the tech industry.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: CDI - CHEF DE PRODUIT SENIOR CHAINE ET TRAME FEMME (H/F)
description: LA MAISON JACQUEMUS Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France. Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture. Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière). Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street). VOTRE RÔLE Le/la Chef de produit Senior Chaîne & Trame Femme est en charge du développement des catégories C&T, Denim et Cuir. Il/Elle est en lien avec la direction créative et assure le développement des collections dans le respect des objectifs de prix, de qualité et de délais. Le poste combine une forte implication opérationnelle sur le développement produit ainsi que le management de 2 chefs de produit et d’une alternante. VOS MISSIONS Produit : piloter le développement des modèles chaîne & trame femme (incl. denim et cuir) du brief à la normalisation. Assurer la mise au point des produits (du 1er prototype au SMS) et garantir la qualité, le bien-aller et la cohérence produit. Sécuriser la faisabilité industrielle tout en proposant des ajustements adaptés. Coûts : contribuer au respect des cibles prix et marge, en intégrant les contraintes industrielles dès le développement et en proposant des optimisations si nécessaire. Suivi & coordination : piloter les échanges avec les façonniers, assurer le lien avec les différents intervenants (studio, tissus et fournitures, merchandising, atelier et production), et garantir la bonne circulation de l’information. Suivre l’avancement des développements, anticiper les risques et veiller au respect des différents jalons de développement. Management : encadrer 3 ressources, organiser les priorités, accompagner le suivi des développements et garantir la bonne tenue du périmètre. VOTRE PROFIL Solide expérience en développement chaîne & trame femme, incluant denim et cuir. Excellente compréhension des process industriels, de la mise au point produit et des exigences qualité. Capacité à piloter plusieurs projets simultanément dans un environnement créatif et exigeant. Rigueur, sens du détail, autonomie et forte capacité d’adaptation. Aisance dans la coordination avec les équipes internes et les partenaires externes. Première expérience réussie en encadrement ou forte appétence pour le management. title: Alternant·e Sécurité & Conformité
description: 🤝 Qui nous sommes ? Chez Moka.Care nous réinventons la façon de voir la santé mentale en entreprise. Nous croyons que des équipes qui se sentent bien créent des entreprises dans lesquelles on s’épanouie et où la performance est durable. Concrètement, Moka.Care offre une solution complète de prévention en santé mentale : Nous accompagnons les salariés avec des sessions individuelles, une application de self-care et un outil de micro-learning intégré à Slack et Teams. Nous aidons les équipes RH avec une interface de data analytics automatisée et des conseils personnalisés d'experts. Où en sommes-nous actuellement ? Depuis décembre 2019, plus de 400 entreprises, dont L'Oréal, Spendesk et Engie, ont rejoint Moka.Care, bénéficiant à plus de 350 000 collaborateurs dans le monde entier. Nous avons levé 17,5 millions d'euros auprès d'investisseurs et de business angels de premier rang. Notre croyance fondamentale : l'excellence in care est notre obsession. La culture n'est pas juste des jolis mots que l'on affiche sur les murs mais incarnons nos valeurs tangibles : l’empathie comme fondement, un optimisme insatiable, une responsabilité partagée et de l’agilité. 🧑‍💻 Pourquoi nous avons besoin de toi ! Contexte Nous évoluons dans un environnement sensible et réglementé : nous accompagnons des collaborateurs sur leur santé mentale et traitons des données de santé. La sécurité et la conformité sont des critères décisifs pour nos clients. La fonction sécurité est en place (RSSI, référentiels, démarches de certification HDS et ISO 27001, préparation à l'AI Act) et nous cherchons un·e alternant·e pour la renforcer, aussi bien sur la conformité que sur la sécurité technique. Tu travailleras directement avec le RSSI, qui t'accompagnera au quotidien. Alternance : idéalement, un rythme de 1 à 2 semaines en entreprise et le reste du mois à l’école , pour une durée d’ un an , avec un démarrage en janvier . Nous restons toutefois ouverts à d’autres rythmes d’alternance. Au quotidien, tu vas : Préparer les réponses aux questionnaires sécurité et conformité de nos clients et prospects, avec le RSSI Maintenir à jour la documentation de sécurité (politiques, procédures, registres, preuves d'audit) Contribuer à l'évaluation de la sécurité de nos fournisseurs et sous-traitants Participer aux revues périodiques: accès, configurations, inventaires Renforcer la sécurité de notre infrastructure : intégrer et ajuster les contrôles automatisés et trier les résultats avec l'équipe tech Optimiser et durcir nos outils de sécurité, comme Bastion : revue de configuration, politiques d'accès, journalisation Réaliser des tests d'intrusion internes sur un périmètre défini et autorisé, avec pour objectif de les automatiser Contribuer à la sensibilisation des équipes et à la veille réglementaire Outils internes : Slack (communication), Notion (knowledge base), Google Drive, 1password (secure password tool). 📇 Tu es la personne idéale si: Tu as de bonnes bases en réseau, chiffrement et gestion des accès Tu as des notions de CI/CD et de scripting Tu connais les méthodologies de test d'intrusion (OWASP, outils usuels) Tu connais le RGPD ; des notions d'ISO 27001 sont un plus Tu es rigoureux·se, organisé·e et curieux·se des deux versants du métier, technique et réglementaire Tu rédiges clairement, en français comme en anglais 🚀 En nous rejoignant tu vas : Participer à une aventure entrepreneuriale avec une mission forte. Voir chaque jour l'impact concret de ton travail et participer à notre ambition : devenir leader européen des solutions de santé mentale B2B. Grandir en tant que personne et apprendre au sein d'une équipe exigeante. Etre responsable de ses objectifs dès le départ : nous recrutons des personnes exceptionnelles pour nous emmener au niveau suivant. 🤩 Nous prenons soin de toi: Accès à M oka.Care : selfcare, sessions individuelles et de groupe et la possibilité de tester les nouvelles features ! Work-life balance : 60% au bureau (on veut passer du temps ensemble) et le reste en remote si tu le souhaites (2 jours / semaine ou 1 semaine / mois). Des bureaux très agréables à Bastille avec une salle de sport, un rooftop. Cagnotte May , à hauteur de 125€ net / mois Swile pour les tickets restaurants à hauteur 10€ / jour GymLib , pour faire du sport Leeto , pour des centaines d’avantages et de réductions, grâce à notre CSE Mutuelle : SideCare 50% du pass Navigo ou Veligo 🎤 Processus de recrutement Notre philosophie : un processus de recrutement équilibré. 30 minutes - screening 🤳 pour comprendre ton parcours et tes aspirations Une étude de cas et un job focused interview 🧑‍💻 pour te permettre de te projeter sur le quotidien que tu pourrais avoir Et un Values fit interview pour s’assurer mutuellement que notre cadre et nos valeurs te conviendront Entre chaque étape tu as un feedback et si besoin nous organisons également des échanges informels avec l’équipe. title: Senior Engineering Manager
description: Engineering has changed, and we're changing with it. We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead multiple teams into AI-native, agentic software delivery — building products used by thousands of eCommerce merchants worldwide. We're not hiring for where engineering was. We're hiring for where it's going. your impact You'll lead several engineering teams and their managers, and shape how we build software as AI reshapes the craft. From spec to delivery, you'll move us toward agentic and multi-agent workflows — with the quality, security and cost controls to back them up. We build on and around Shopify, which moves just as fast, so staying current isn't a nice-to-have here. It's the job. You'll work from our Leicester city centre office three days a week, with two days remote. what you'll do: Lead and grow multiple engineering teams and their managers, building a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence. Set long-term technical strategy with the architecture team and senior leadership, so engineering moves in step with company goals. Own roadmaps for complex, distributed, high-traffic systems — with resilience, observability and performance built in at scale. Raise AI maturity across your teams against our maturity model, moving from prompt, context and harness practices to agentic loops and multi-agent workflows. Keep building with new tools yourself so you stay sharp. Drive adoption of our AI development standards, including quality controls for AI-generated code. Manage AI tooling spend against the value it delivers, and escalate tooling gaps that block progress. Manage cross-team dependencies and handoffs, especially as agentic workflows change how work moves between teams. Lead hiring, performance and leadership development — growing your managers' AI fluency and recognising progress in performance and promotion decisions. Keep us secure and compliant, including governing what data AI tools and models can access. what you'll bring 8+ years in software engineering, including 4+ years in leadership, ideally managing managers. A degree in Computer Science or Engineering, or equivalent experience. A track record of scaling engineering organisations and landing new practices across multiple teams. Deep knowledge of large-scale system design, microservices and cloud-native architecture. Recent hands-on experience building working apps or tools with AI development tooling, and a clear view of its cost, security and quality tradeoffs. Experience balancing tech debt, reliability and feature delivery. Experience managing budgets, headcount and resourcing, including AI tooling and token spend. The influence to shape executive decisions and product strategy, and the coaching skills to grow strong leaders. Nice to have : Experience leading agentic workflows eCommerce experience, especially with Shopify Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. We hire for potential and mindset as much as experience - if this role excites you, we want to hear from you. life at clearer.io eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on. We connect to the stack a merchant already uses. Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide. We're a global team with offices in Australia, the UK, Germany, Vietnam and the US, backed for the long term by PSG Equity and Silversmith Capital Partners. We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric. What guides us day to day: Customers at the heart: we obsess over their needs so we can grow together Purposeful progress: we don't settle - we take initiative and embrace bold thinking Endless innovation: we refine, improve, and take meaningful action Always open: we build trust through transparency and global collaboration clear benefits Private Medical Insurance with Vitality from day one - including private GP access, a 24/7 medical helpline and advanced cancer cover Dental, optical and hearing cover Mental health support - unlimited CBT (first 8 sessions without GP referral) and a confidential Employee Assistance Programme 20 days PTO and 6 bank holidays - plus the full week off between Christmas Eve and New Year's Day Hybrid working Your birthday off - a full paid day, just for you, every year Give Back Day - a paid day each year to volunteer for a cause you care about Bonusly peer recognition - real-time shout-outs tied to our values, with points that convert to real rewards Clearer Together - each quarter, one employee who exemplifies our values wins a fully-funded 5-night trip to one of our global offices (Sydney, Berlin, Leicester, Irvine or Ho Chi Minh City) Stopover - travelling near one of our offices? Once a year we'll fund a day with the local team a fair shot for everyone We're committed to a fair and inclusive hiring experience. Hiring decisions at clearer.io are based on skills, experience and role requirements - nothing else. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just tell us; it won't affect your application. If you want to lead engineering through its biggest shift yet, and help make eCommerce growth simpler, smarter and clearer - we'd love to hear from you. Apply now. title: Automotive MCU Chip Architect
description: We are looking for an experienced Automotive MCU Chip Architect to define the system and subsystem architecture of next-generation automotive microcontrollers. The role includes ownership of chip-level architecture concepts, subsystem partitioning, compute and memory architecture, interconnect strategy, safety and security integration, power/reset/clock concepts, and hardware/software interface definition. The successful candidate will work closely with product management, safety, security, design, verification, software, and implementation teams to ensure the MCU architecture meets demanding automotive requirements for real-time performance, functional safety, cybersecurity, reliability, scalability, and cost efficiency. What you'll do Key Responsibilities System Architecture Definition Define the overall automotive MCU architecture from product, customer, and market requirements. Translate use cases into chip-level requirements covering performance, safety, security, power, cost, and scalability. Drive system partitioning across CPUs, memories, interconnects, peripherals, safety/security functions, debug, test, and power domains. Own architecture trade-offs and document decision rationale for reuse across MCU families and derivatives. Subsystem Architecture Ownership Align subsystem concepts and interfaces across compute, memory, bus/interconnect, peripheral, safety, security, power/reset/clock, debug/trace, and DFT/test domains. Ensure subsystem requirements are implementation-feasible and verifiable at RTL, subsystem, chip, silicon, and software levels. Define hardware/software-visible architecture elements such as memory maps, register model principles, interrupts, DMA, boot flow, and access-control concepts. Cross-Functional Technical Leadership Lead architecture reviews and resolve trade-offs between product management, system engineering, safety, security, design, verification, software, backend, test, and validation teams. Provide technical guidance during concept, design, verification, silicon bring-up, qualification, and customer support phases. Ensure architectural consistency, requirement traceability, and risk closure across global engineering teams. What we require Required Technical Expertise MCU / SoC Architecture Deep understanding of real-time MCU architectures, CPU subsystems, memories, peripheral integration, low-power design, product-family scalability, and silicon implementation constraints. Automotive Functional Safety Practical ISO 26262 expertise including ASIL concepts, safety goals, technical safety requirements, FMEDA/DFA/FTA awareness, and definition of safety mechanisms at system and subsystem level. Automotive Cybersecurity Understanding of secure boot, hardware root of trust, HSM integration, cryptographic accelerators, key management, lifecycle states, secure debug, and ISO/SAE 21434 concepts. Digital Design and Implementation Awareness Ability to reason about RTL feasibility, timing, area, power, DFT, backend constraints, IP integration, verification closure, and bring-up observability. Embedded Software Awareness Working knowledge of startup software, boot flows, drivers, AUTOSAR concepts, RTOS use, interrupts, memory protection, debug, and software-visible register behavior. Required Experience 10+ years in semiconductor, MCU, SoC, or embedded systems development. Several years in system architecture, subsystem architecture, or senior technical leadership. Hands-on experience with automotive MCU or automotive SoC products. Experience across concept definition, architecture specification, design support, verification support, silicon bring-up, qualification, and customer support. Vous veiller au quotidien à ce que l’ensemble de l’équipe du Club fasse preuve d’une attitude positive, en accord avec les valeurs de Soho House Paris.</p> <p><strong> </strong><strong>Missions principales et responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li>Superviser les activités afférentes à la Restauration précisément du Club, du Bar et du Cabaret</li> <li>Recruter, encadrer, développer et former saisonnalités des produits, qualités des produits et retours éventuels des membres</li> <li>S’assurer et effectuer les contrôles et les inspections des installations et équipements techniques des title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description: <p>As a Forward Deployed Engineer at Auterion, you will play a pivotal role in the successful development, integration and deployment of Auterion-powered drone systems. </p> <p>In this role, you will collaborate closely with the production, hardware engineering, and firmware/software teams, as well as operations, ensuring that every platform transitions smoothly from an airframe concept into a fully validated flying robot ready for deployment. You will serve as the primary technical interface for partners, work closely with them to understand their technical requirements, configure and adapt existing solutions, contribute to core software development, and ensure successful implementation. </p> <p>This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys combining hands-on technical work with customer collaboration and system-level problem solving, bridging the gap between hardware, firmware, and real-world flight performance. </p> <p><strong>Responsibilities and Duties</strong></p> <ul> <li>Operate in a highly hands-on environment with evolving system requirements, rapidly iterating across hardware and software integration challenges.</li> <li>Manage software releases and perform firmware flashing and configuration using PX4 or adjacent autopilot ecosystems, including sensor calibration, ESC tuning, and system bring-up.</li> <li>Provide deep avionics and airframe expertise, including autopilot tuning, sensor and payload integration, power systems and airworthiness considerations.</li> <li>Work independently to troubleshoot integration and flight-readiness issues while collaborating cross-functionally with hardware engineering, firmware/software teams, operations, and QC engineering to escalate complex challenges when required.</li> <li>Act as the primary technical authority in customer engagements, translating mission requirements into concrete system architectures and demonstrable solutions built on AuterionOS and Skynode.</li> <li>Participate in flight testing activities to validate platform stability, safety, and mission performance, resolving technical issues often directly in the field during customer trials and demonstrations.</li> <li>Contribute to technical documentation and continuous improvement of engineering processes.</li> <li>Feed customer and market requirements back into product and engineering teams to influence the roadmap of the Auterion stack.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Degree in Software, Electrical, Mechanical, Aerospace or Robotics Engineering, or a related field</li> <li>Working proficiency in C/C++ and Python: you can read, debug and patch existing code and write small tools and scripts</li> <li>Comfortable in Linux environments, including the command line, logs, Docker and basic networking (IP, TCP/UDP)</li> <li>Hands-on hardware-software integration: system bring-up, wiring and connectors, and embedded interfaces (UART, CAN, I2C, SPI) at a practical level</li> <li>Structured troubleshooting: you can isolate whether a problem is software, hardware, configuration or RF, often under time pressure in the field</li> <li>Strong communicator: you can explain technical issues clearly to customers and operators, and report findings back to engineering in a way they can act on</li> <li>Willing to travel and work on-site with customers, including at test ranges and in field environments</li> <li>EU citizenship (required for security clearance and customer requirements)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-have</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with PX4 or ArduPilot, MAVLink, QGroundControl or mission planning tools</li> <li>UAV flight testing and validation in operational environments</li> <li>Experience with datalinks and radio systems</li> <li>Previous customer-facing or field engineering role, especially with defense or government customers</li> <li>German language skills</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Pension plan </li> <li>Extended social security package </li> <li>Enhanced maternity & paternity leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Auterion</strong></p> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who we are </strong></p> <p>At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to<a class="c-link" href="https://customers.twilio.com/" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://customers.twilio.com/" data-sk="tooltip_parent"> hundreds of thousands of businesses </a>and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.</p> <p>Our dedication to <a class="c-link" href="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.twilio.com/en-us/blog/open-work" data-sk="tooltip_parent">remote-first work</a>, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.<br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p> <p><strong>Hiring and how we work</strong></p> <p>We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! </p> <p>Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. <br><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">.</span></p></div><p><strong>See yourself at Twilio</strong></p> <p>Join the team as Twilio’s next Strategic Account Executive. </p> <p><strong>About the job</strong></p> <p>This position is needed to sell into high value prospects and customers. This person will play a key role in further growing the business across EMEA with a particular focus on Southern Europe. The candidate will be responsible for managing fast growing customers in the region. Focused mainly on Product cross and up-sell and GP growth, as well as sourcing net new opportunities within a set of accounts.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll:</p> <ul> <li>Servicing the fastest growing customers in the region.</li> <li>Growing our revenue and gross profit share of wallet within your key account list. </li> <li>Opening doors to the purchase of Twilio’s products and services - including voice, messaging, email, contact centre, account security software.</li> <li>Maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.</li> <li>Create pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process.</li> <li>Selling solutions to a technical and business audience. </li> <li>Building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.</li> <li>Thinking outside of the box and having extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.</li> <li>Balancing challenging priorities and handling multiple projects/deals at the same time.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications </strong></p> <p>Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. You will primarily work on our Mission Control Software and build supporting tools used by flight controllers and engineering teams. operational needs Write performant, maintainable, and well-documented code Ensure reliability through automated testing and operational validation Support users and contribute to improving development workflows and tooling Mentor junior engineers and contribute to a strong engineering culture What we would love to see from you The ideal candidate will have: Experience with backend development using Python and/or Ruby (on Rails) Frontend experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue.js, or similar) Familiarity with object-oriented programming concepts and design principles Experience MinIO, AWS S3) for handling large datasets Experience with version control systems such as Git Familiarity with automated testing frameworks Ability to design, build, and maintain scalable distributed systems Solid understanding of software design patterns and engineering best practices Experience working in agile software development environments Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills Attention to detail with the ability to balance quality and delivery speed Motivation to thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment Bonus qualifications: Experience with relational or domains Why you should join us! title: Software Development Engineer III, Maps API
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. The Maps API team builds and maintains the applications and infrastructure responsible for creating and distributing Mapbox maps . Thousands of customers rely on our services to seamlessly handle billions of requests every day, scale in real-time to global events, and enable designers, developers, and analysts to make and share maps we’ve never dreamed of. Delivering maps means delivering a model of the world that’s changing all the time and needs to automatically support the world’s edge cases – writing systems, fonts, local regulations, and global boundary disputes. Our team maintains the highest-traffic read APIs at Mapbox and the distributed ETL pipelines used by internal and external customers to turn data into maps. We’re building new ways for people to visualize location data. Check out our Mapbox maps ! As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You’ll Do As a Software Development Engineer III on the Maps API team, you will be responsible for balancing rapid development of new mapping tools against the reliability of our services as they scale into new request volumes, markets, and use cases. In a single week on the Maps API team, you might write application code robust to a world’s worth of data, build and deploy microservices, diagnose complex system behavior as global markets drive traffic in unexpected ways, or facilitate continuous delivery at Mapbox. In this role, you can expect to: Lead your engineering team to identify and scope out well-defined tasks. Execute on the scope and be accountable for delivering on time with quality. Design systems and make architectural decisions that will keep pace with the rapid growth of Mapbox’s customer base. Mentor your peers through 1:1s, facilitating design and code reviews, and providing continuous guidance to foster professional growth and technical excellence. Promote a culture of operational excellence by meticulously testing and monitoring our systems and code, writing documentation, and being on-call to support the health of our services. Reduce technical debt, share your knowledge, and invest in your teammates’ health and happiness, while optimizing application performance and accelerating feature velocity. Uphold a culture of collaboration, transparency, creativity, inclusion, and data-driven decisions. What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role 8-10+ years of experience building scalable high volume low latency backend services. Proficiency with Python, NodeJS, and native AWS (CDK, ECS, Step Functions, Lambda, S3, RDS, CloudWatch, CloudFront). Experience building mapping and geospatial related products. Familiarity with code versioning tools, such as GitHub. Able to perform independently all the development tasks, based on designs and specs. Self-starter who is communication and outcomes-oriented. An empirical analytical approach. You develop strong hypotheses, conduct spikes, and clearly communicate your findings. A desire to share your expertise through documentation, mentorship, pairing, and both written and verbal discussion. A desire to work with and lead individuals with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. High quality mindset -- write unit tests, proactively remedy defects and follow through to production. Nice to Have Traits for This Role Proficiency in C++ What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How we support you Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Rest & Recharge: Paid time away, company holidays, and generous absence policies. Time Off to Give Back: Dedicated paid volunteering time in addition to your standard PTO. JavaScript/React: solide Erfahrung im Frontend, jQuery schreckt dich nicht ab Datenbanken: relationale Datenbanken wie MySQL/MariaDB oder SingleStore und sicherer Umgang mit SQL Tooling: Git und Arbeit mit CI/CD Sprache: Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, Englisch mindestens B1 Arbeitsweise: eigenständig, strukturiert, proaktiv und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch Persönlich: Du kommunizierst verlässlich, arbeitest gern im Team, übernimmst Verantwortung, hast keine Angst vor schwierigen Codestellen und gibst dein Wissen gern weiter. title: Senior Associate - Materials
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Company Description:</strong> Systemiq is a system-change company committed to achieving the Sustainable Development Goals and the Paris Agreement by transforming markets and business models across five key systems: nature and food, materials and circularity, energy, urban areas, and sustainable finance.</p> <p>As a certified B Corp, we combine strategic advisory with high-impact, on-the-ground work, partnering with business, finance, policymakers and civil society to deliver system change. With offices across Africa, Asia, Europe and the Americas, we are dedicated exclusively to sustainability-focused work.</p> <p></p> <p> </p></div><p></p> <h2>Strategy Associate, Materials & Circular Economy</h2> <p><strong>Location: London preferred. Amsterdam also possible</strong></p> <p>Systemiq is looking for a Strategy Associate to join our Materials & Circular Economy team. This role is suited to someone who combines strong strategic thinking with the intellectual curiosity to tackle complex sustainability challenges.</p> <p>You will work on some of the most important questions facing companies, governments and wider society as they shift towards more circular and sustainable models. Projects can range from shaping corporate strategy and identifying new business opportunities to assessing value chains, developing policy recommendations and designing system-level interventions.</p> <p>We are looking for someone who can bring the core toolkit and pace of a strong strategy consultant: structured problem-solving, analytical rigour, clear communication and sound judgement. Strategy consulting experience is one route to demonstrating this. We are equally interested in candidates from other demanding analytical environments who can show the same quality of thinking and ability to turn complexity into clear recommendations.</p> <p>You will join small, senior-led project teams and take meaningful responsibility from the outset. You will structure problems, conduct analysis, develop insights and work directly with clients to translate those insights into practical strategic choices.</p> <h3>Responsibilities</h3> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Structure complex problems:</strong> break ambiguous questions into clear workstreams, hypotheses and analytical priorities.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Generate insights:</strong> conduct rigorous qualitative and quantitative analysis, drawing conclusions from incomplete or complex information.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Shape recommendations:</strong> translate analysis into clear, concise and practical strategic recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Develop client materials:</strong> produce high-quality presentations, briefings and other client-ready outputs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engage with clients:</strong> work directly with senior stakeholders across businesses, governments, foundations and non-governmental organisations.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Contribute to project direction:</strong> help shape project approaches, hypotheses and emerging strategic conclusions.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Build trusted relationships:</strong> work effectively with clients, partners and stakeholders across multi-organisation initiatives.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>About the team</h3> <p>You will be part of Systemiq's Materials & Circular Economy platform, led by Partner Ben Dixon.</p> <p>Ben works across circular economy and energy topics and has advised organisations including the Ellen MacArthur Foundation, the United Nations International Resource Panel and multinational companies across packaging, chemicals and related sectors. He also leads Systemiq's work on plastics, focused on accelerating the transition towards a more circular and resource-efficient plastics system.</p> <h3>What we are looking for</h3> <h4>Strategy and analytical capability</h4> <p>We are looking for candidates who already demonstrate, or can quickly operate with, the core toolkit expected in strategy consulting. You should be able to:</p> <ul> <li> <p>Structure complex and ambiguous problems into clear components, hypotheses and analytical questions.</p> </li> <li> <p>Apply strong analytical judgement to qualitative and quantitative information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Synthesize complex material into concise insights and decision-relevant recommendations.</p> </li> <li> <p>Communicate clearly in writing and verbally, including through high-quality presentation materials.</p> </li> <li> <p>Work effectively at pace, managing changing priorities and imperfect information.</p> </li> <li> <p>Move comfortably between detailed analysis and the broader strategic question.</p> </li> </ul> <h4>Experience and background</h4> <p>You will typically bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>At least two years of experience in strategy consulting, advisory or another analytically demanding environment.</p> </li> <li> <p>Evidence of strong performance and increasing responsibility in your previous roles.</p> </li> <li> <p>Experience contributing to strategy, investment, commercial or other decision-focused work.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong academic achievement, typically including a Master's degree or equivalent experience.</p> </li> </ul> <p>We particularly welcome candidates from strategy consulting, but relevant experience could also come from corporate strategy, investing, high-growth businesses, specialist advisory firms or other project-based environments where structured thinking and analytical rigour are central to the role.</p> <h4>Sector interest and understanding</h4> <p>You do not need to be a specialist across every part of the Materials & Circular Economy agenda. You should, however, bring:</p> <ul> <li> <p>An understanding of, or demonstrated ability to learn, complex industrial and consumer value chains.</p> </li> <li> <p>Exposure to sectors such as plastics, petrochemicals, chemicals, consumer goods, manufacturing, mobility, energy or waste management.</p> </li> <li> <p>A strong interest in sustainability, circular economy and the economic and strategic questions involved in system change.</p> </li> </ul> <h3>Location</h3> <p>London is the preferred location for this role. We would also consider Amsterdam for candidates whose experience and capabilities are an especially strong match for the position.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div id="description__body"></div> <p><strong data-start="578" data-end="603">Diversity & Inclusion</strong><br data-start="603" data-end="606">At Systemiq, we absolutely believe diverse perspectives are essential to driving system change. description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Join Axon and be a Force for Good.</strong></h4> <p>At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. title: Software Engineer, Backend
description: <h2><strong>About the team</strong></h2> <p>Restaurants run on a stack of tools that rarely talk to each other: one for delivery, another for online orders, another for reservations, another for loyalty, and a till that knows nothing about any of them. The same guest can look like three different customers across three different systems.</p> <p>DashOS is DoorDash's platform for fixing that. It connects marketplace ordering, direct ordering, reservations, loyalty, guest management, marketing and point of sale around one shared view of the guest, so every product gets smarter as the others are used. DoorDash launched DashOS publicly at Dash Forward in September 2026, and from 2027 more than 80,000 restaurants on leading POS and middleware partners.</p> <p>DashOS Engineering brings together engineers from across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt into one global organisation, led from London. Our teams cover reservations and guest CRM, digital ordering and omnichannel loyalty, POS and self-order kiosks, AI-powered marketing and Voice AI, and the shared data and integration platforms that connect them. Each team owns its own roadmap. The shared mission is making them work as one system.</p> <h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>We're looking for a backend-focused Software Engineer to build the high-performance, highly available services that restaurants depend on every day, from booking a table on a Friday night to recognising a regular the moment they order. You'll work closely with other engineers, product managers and designers, and because DashOS is newly launched, you'll help shape how its products connect rather than inheriting decisions someone else already made.</p> <h2><strong>You're excited about this opportunity because you will...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Design, build, test, deploy and improve backend services for customer-facing features used by restaurants and their guests in markets around the world.</li> <li>Own features end to end, from technical design through to launch and ongoing support, including taking part in an on-call rotation to keep systems reliable.</li> <li>Work on hard problems in data, latency and scale: unifying guest identity across channels, real-time availability search across thousands of venues, and integrations with the systems restaurants already run.</li> <li>Build on DoorDash's global platform, so the features you ship can reach restaurants across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt markets rather than being rebuilt for each one.</li> <li>Work in a modern engineering environment with frequent daily releases, feature flags and AI coding agents used across code review, deployment and debugging.</li> <li>Partner with engineers, product managers and designers across London and other DashOS locations to decide what to build and how.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're excited about you because...</strong></h2> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, and a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> <li>You've built and operated backend services or web applications in production, with strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms and system design.</li> <li>You're fluent in at least one modern backend language (we mostly use Python), and you're happy to pick up new languages and tools as the platform evolves.</li> <li>You care about the people using what you build, and you take ownership of technical solutions from first design to production.</li> <li>You use AI coding tools as part of how you work, or you're keen to, and you're comfortable reviewing and taking responsibility for what they produce.</li> <li>You enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve problems that don't have an obvious answer yet.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Tech you'll work with</strong></h2> <p>Our services are built mainly in Python, with performance-critical systems in Rust, running on Google Cloud and DoorDash's global platform. AI coding agents are part of how we design, review and ship code, so we care more about how you solve problems than about which languages you've used before. You won't need to know every part of the stack on day one.</p> <h2><strong>Where and how we work</strong></h2> <p>This role is based in our London office at The River Building, on a hybrid pattern of 3 days a week in the office.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h1><strong>About SevenRooms</strong></h1> <p>In 2011, Joel Montaniel, Allison Page, and Kinesh Patel founded SevenRooms after noticing that hospitality operators were missing a critical ingredient in the systems they were using to run their business: guest data. What began as a mission to help restaurants better understand and serve their guests evolved into a powerful platform used by merchants around the world.</p> <p>With best-in-class tools for marketing, operations, and guest experience — all deeply integrated with its industry-leading CRM — SevenRooms empowers operators to drive revenue, streamline operations, and deliver experiences that keep guests coming back.</p> <p>In 2025, DoorDash acquired SevenRooms to strengthen its in-store strategy and expand its merchant-first offerings. The combination brings together DoorDash’s scale, reach, and digital innovation with SevenRooms’ in-store capabilities to support hospitality businesses across every channel — from discovery and delivery to on-premise dining.</p> <p>As DoorDash builds out its in-store capabilities, SevenRooms plays a central role in enabling merchants to grow their businesses and connect more meaningfully with guests, whether they’re ordering online or dining in. This move reflects DoorDash’s broader commitment to empowering local businesses, fostering stronger connections between consumers and the places they love, and building technology that meets merchants — and their customers — wherever they are.</p> <p><em>Beware of recruitment scams: DoorDash, Deliveroo, and Wolt will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about our legitimate recruiting process at <span class="_80om1qgj _1e0c1nu9" data-testid="smart-link-draggable-inline"><span class="loader-wrapper"><span class="hover-card-trigger-wrapper" data-testid="hover-card-trigger-wrapper"><a class="_1yt4x7n9 _2rko1ssi _v56415x0 _1e0c1nu9 _16d9qvcn _syaz13af _1rkwglyw _4cvx1w55 _19itia51 _bfhkhp5a _1a3b18uv _4fprglyw _5goinqa1 _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _uizt1kdv _nt751r31 _49pcglyw _1hvw1o36 _1372tlke _7ehiw5lj _1j5pglyw _1di615s3" href="https://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-testid="inline-card-resolved-view"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw _o5721jtm _1nmz9jpi _16d9qvcn _ca0qv77o _u5f31b66 _n3tdv77o _19bv1b66" data-testid="inline-card-icon-and-title"><span class="_19itglyw _vchhusvi _r06hglyw">Recruitment Scam Awareness - DoorDash</span></span></a></span></span></span> .</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: IP Rights Manager
description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role As a Legal Operations Specialist – Data Licensing on the IP & Licensing team, you will own the processes that let Mistral license content and data without slowing down. This role exists because we need someone who can turn legal analysis into repeatable workflows — managing rights, obligations, and restrictions across our growing dataset portfolio. You will work closely with the colleagues who negotiate our commercial and legal agreements, turning their work into clear metadata, tracked obligations, and automated systems. Your impact will be visible in how smoothly data moves into our AI products: fewer bottlenecks, clearer rights status, and one reliable record for every data agreement we sign. You will sit where copyright, data protection, and AI meet, making sure that as we acquire and use training data, we comply with EU and US law, respect third-party rights, and enforce the restrictions our contracts impose. In scope: clearing permissions for inbound data, reviewing and codifying contracts, maintaining a central rights-and-obligations database, and building AI-powered workflows that make all of this scalable. What You Will Do Clear inbound data usage requests by researching rights status, scope, obligations, and restrictions — including anonymization and data protection requirements — before data enters our systems. Review data-related agreements and codify their key terms into structured metadata, maintaining our template library and playbook alongside Legal. Assess whether specific AI use cases fall within the scope of third-party agreements, flag gaps, and recommend contract amendments. Build and maintain a central database that serves as the single source of truth for every signed data-related agreement. Track and manage compliance with ongoing obligations — permitted uses, confidentiality, re-use rights — automate our reporting, and administer master licensing partnerships. Verify provenance, ownership, and consent for acquired data, and identify obligations that require active monitoring. Monitor that Mistral clients and partners stay within their granted rights, operating the approval system that enforces legal restrictions. Design and run AI-powered workflows for contract review assistance, obligation extraction, and renewal alerts. What We're Looking For A bachelor's degree in law, publishing, information science, business, or a related field. 2–5 years of experience in copyright, permissions, licensing, legal operations, or contract administration — ideally in an AI, tech, or data-driven environment. Working knowledge of EU and US copyright law and contract administration, with demonstrated ability to interpret contracts independently. Meticulous attention to detail and discretion with confidential contracts, combined with strong project-management skills. Clear, direct communication and the initiative to anticipate needs through ambiguity. A legal-ops mindset: you want to turn legal analysis into repeatable, scalable processes, not just handle one-off reviews. Comfort building agentic AI workflows in a complex enterprise environment — you are an AI power user, ideally with experience setting up such workflows in a legal team. Additional depth in formal legal training, CLM platforms (e.g., Ironclad), publishing-house contracts, or European languages (French, German, Spanish, etc.) is welcome. What We Offer We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page . Privacy Policy Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy . Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Your work will connect what users see with the systems behind it—from a guest’s check-in experience to the workflows coordinating reservations, cleaning, payments, and owner reporting.
