title: Stage Software Development
description: Stage Software Development Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende (afstudeer) stage, waarbij je in aanraking komt met de nieuwste ontwikkelmethodes? Wil je ervaren hoe het is om mee te bouwen aan een platform dat wereldwijd wordt gebruikt door duizenden gebruikers? Dan is een stage bij IXON wellicht iets voor jou! Bij IXON connecten wij machinebouwers met hun klanten en machines. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Bouw jij mee? Verdeeld over verschillende SCRUM-teams is ons R&D-team verantwoordelijk voor het bouwen en ontwikkelen van het IXON Cloud-platform. Elk aspect van onze oplossing, dan de robuuste backend tot de gebruiksvriendelijke frontend, geavanceerde hardware en onze wereldwijde DevOps-infrastructuur, wordt met passie en expertise binnen onze muren ontwikkeld. Ons R&D-team, dat inmiddels bestaat uit meer dan 30 technische specialisten, staat altijd open voor jonge talenten die willen groeien en zich verder willen ontwikkelen. Tijdens elke stageperiode bieden we meerdere plekken aan voor studenten in de volgende deelgebieden: Backend development; Frontend development; Embedded Software Development; DevOps; Security; Software testing. Hierbij kom je aanraking met onze tech-stack, bestaande uit: Python; C++; Rust; Angular; Typescript; Playwright; Zabbix; Linux; MariaDB; Kubernetes; SALT. Uiteraard staan we altijd open voor inbreng van studenten op het gebied van nieuwe tooling, frameworks en technieken. Welke opdrachten kan je verwachten? Studio for e-mail Door de aanhoudende groei van het aantal IXON Cloud-gebruikers neemt de diversiteit aan specifieke wensen toe. Een veelgehoorde behoefte is het personaliseren van e-mailberichten die vanuit het platform naar de eindgebruikers worden verstuurd. Momenteel zijn de aanpassingsmogelijkheden beperkt tot enkel de kleuren en logo's. Het doel van deze opdracht is om klanten volledige controle te bieden over de vormgeving en inhoud van hun e-mails. Om dit te realiseren, wordt een intuïtieve e-mailstudio ontwikkeld waarmee de gebruiker eenvoudig en naar eigen inzicht berichten kan opstellen en beheren. Support Beckhoff ADS via pull application (Embedded Software Development) Implementeer ondersteuning voor het Beckhoff ADS-protocol in C++ om de compatibiliteit van de IXON data pipeline te vergroten. Je realiseert de volledige koppeling op de gateway en maakt data-logging eenvoudig configureerbaar in de fleet manager. Het versnellen van End-to-End (E2E) testen (Software testing) Optimaliseer de End-to-End testomgeving van de IXON Cloud om de feedbackcyclus en release-snelheid voor ontwikkelaars te verhogen. Je identificeert knelpunten en implementeert versnellingsoplossingen binnen de GitLab CI/CD-pipeline. Hier herken jij jezelf in Je bent een HBO student in de richting van (Embedded) Software Development, Security of aanverwant en bent op zoek naar een (afstudeer)stage met impact. Je hebt een passie voor het ontwikkelen van toffe softwareoplossingen en krijgt graag de vrijheid om nieuwe dingen uit te proberen. Daarbij ga je niet voor shortcuts, maar werk je gestructureerd aan kwalitatieve oplossingen. Daarnaast ben je een echte teamplayer, die daardoor moeiteloos meedraait in een van onze SCRUM teams. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Een mooie stagevergoeding; Een relaxte werkomgeving met jonge en ambitieuze developers, met wie je altijd kunt sparren over de nieuwste technologieën; Flexibele werktijden en de mogelijkheid om thuis te werken; Doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen onze organisatie. Klaar om impact te maken? Connect met IXON en ontdek onze stagemogelijkheden! Solliciteren kan snel en gemakkelijk, door te klikken op de onderstaande knop. Behoefte aan meer details? description: Ben jij er klaar voor om impact te hebben op een van de belangrijkste sectoren in de wereld? Bij IXON connecten wij machines met hun makers. Door machinebouwers wereldwijd toegang te geven tot hun machines en data zorgen wij voor een revolutie in industrial automation. Met onze end-to-end oplossing, bestaande uit een cloudplatform met geïntegreerde remote access, geven wij machinebouwers de tools en technologie in handen om hun businessmodellen te transformeren en daarmee toekomstbestendig te blijven. Dit alles met als doel: Efficiëntere productie met de laagst mogelijke impact op de wereld. Hier krijg jij energie van Tijdens deze stage van een half jaar (startende in februari) ga je aan de slag met de uitrol van Business Control binnen onze R&D-afdeling, waar dit op dit moment nog niet aanwezig is. Wij geloven dat het geluk van de mens hem zit in het hebben van autonomie, een doel (purpose) en de kans om te groeien. Business control heeft daar een enorme impact op! Doordat de behaalde resultaten zichtbaar worden, kunnen deze gevierd worden en zie je direct hoe je zelf presteert en groeit binnen het bedrijf. Business control op R&D is best een uitdaging, want regels code tellen is niet de oplossing en de opbrengst van nieuwe producten is vaak nog lastig in te schatten. Jij gaat de uitdaging aan om toch controle te krijgen over de business! Hoewel geen dag hetzelfde is, houd jij je tijdens een gemiddelde werkweek onder andere bezig met de volgende activiteiten: De bestaande rapportagestructuur en kosten binnen de R&D-afdeling in kaart brengen; Het maken van een concreet uitrolplan (waaronder het bepalen van KPI's, rapportages en reviews); Meehelpen met rapportageverbeteringen en overkoepelend meekijken op de afdeling; Wanneer er tijd is: een pilot draaien met één van onze teams om jouw theorie in de praktijk te brengen. Dit maakt jou succesvol in deze rol Jij past perfect bij de pioniersgeest van onze organisatie. Dit betekent dat je niet bang bent om buiten de lijntjes te kleuren, initiatief te nemen en daardoor dus graag aan de slag gaat met nieuwe inzichten en projecten. Daarnaast ben je analytisch sterk, werk je graag zelfstandig en ben je van nature erg nieuwsgierig. Wat wij van jou verwachten: Je bent een Bachelor student in de richting Finance, Bedrijfseconomie of soortgelijk; Je bent beschikbaar voor een stageduur van een half jaar (startende in februari); Je hebt de gedrevenheid om een complexe uitdaging, zoals het meetbaar maken van R&D, aan te vliegen. Dit hebben wij jou te bieden Binnen deze rol krijg je de vrijheid en kans om een cruciale rol te spelen in het succes van een organisatie met enorme internationale marktpotentie. Je maakt deel uit van een stimulerende en internationale werkomgeving, waarin je kunt samenwerken met getalenteerde en ambitieuze professionals en de ruimte krijgt om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. title: Senior Software Engineer - Digital Workplace
description: <h3> </h3> <p>Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.</p> <p>The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <h3>The role</h3> <p>We build internal systems to the same standard as our public products: specified, tested, reviewed and observable. We want engineers who enjoy that rigour and take full ownership of what they ship.</p> <h3><strong>What you will do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Design and deliver systems and platforms, including intuitive UIs</li> <li>Build Go services and APIs that connect many data sources</li> <li>Design data models and architecture for connected systems</li> <li>Turn data into clear dashboards and visualisations</li> <li>Build LLM-powered features into everyday workflows</li> <li>Write specs, estimate work and deliver to agreed criteria</li> <li>Set a high bar in code review, testing and documentation</li> <li>Partner with non-technical colleagues to turn needs into tools</li> <li>Mentor engineers and improve how the team works</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Who you are</strong></h3> <p>You have deep expertise in at least two of:</p> <ul> <li>Back-end services in Go</li> <li>Modern front-end engineering [React/Svelte/TypeScript]</li> <li>Data engineering and analytics</li> <li>Data visualisation</li> <li>Applied LLM/ML in production workflows</li> </ul> <p>You also:</p> <ul> <li>Treat testing, security, performance and accessibility as part of the job</li> <li>Handle sensitive people data with care</li> <li>Write clearly and work well in a distributed team</li> <li>Own your work from first spec to production</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have</strong>: Python, Go, React, Svelte, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, a history of building tools for HR, finance or operations.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The ideal candidate will use their passion for experimentation and analytics to build tomorrow’s tech organisation. This team will help us gain insights into the business and our talent pool, and use those insights to improve the experience of working at Canonical.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">As a Workplace Engineer at Canonical, you need an analytical, data-driven mind and a passion to connect and make sense of interesting data from APIs. We focus heavily on the collection of metrics, optimising processes, and ways of working across Canonical.  You need to demonstrate leadership, excellence, and consistency and will mentor others in the team.</span></p> <h3><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</span></p> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual compensation review</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Recognition rewards</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Annual holiday leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Maternity and paternity leave</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</span></li> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events</span></li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</span></p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.</span><a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</span></a></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">#LI-remote</span></p> <p> </p>

title: Senior Control Systems Engineer
description: Fusionality is building the measurement, simulation and control stack of the fusion energy reactors of the future. Our technology enables effective and reliable operation, monitoring, and analysis of high-temperature plasmas in fusion devices — which will one day provide clean, practically limitless power to the grid. We have spun out of EPFL’s Swiss Plasma Center and have just completed our pre-seed fundraise. We are looking for a Senior Control Systems Engineer to join our founding team in Lausanne and help build our core technology. This job is for you if you are a passionate engineer with deep knowledge cutting across real-time / embedded systems, software and hardware, and excited about building the systems to monitor and control real-world fusion plasmas. Fluency in a mix of high-level and low-level languages such as C, C++, Rust, MATLAB/Simulink, Python. Obsession with code quality, testing and reliability. Experience with distributed real-time systems, real-time networking and field buses and/or SCADA is an advantage. Experience with embedded/μC/FPGA technologies and/or safety critical systems is an advantage. Benefits The unique opportunity to play a foundational role at a dynamic, fast-growing startup, shaping the technical solutions and products from the ground up. Great working conditions, located in Lausanne, Switzerland, a city and country known for its high quality of life. title: Product Cost Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Austin, TX</strong></li> <li><strong>San Francisco, CA</strong></li> <li><strong>Denver, CO</strong></li> <li><strong>Seattle, WA</strong></li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Summary</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Financial Analyst to join our R&D Finance team and help explain what it costs to build, deliver and scale Cloudflare’s products. You will partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure Finance and Pricing to turn technical resource usage and infrastructure investment into clear product unit economics and actionable financial insights.</p> <p>This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who enjoys moving between financial models, operational data and cross-functional problem solving. You will help improve the data and processes behind our analysis, using automation and AI thoughtfully to make recurring work more reliable and scalable. As the work evolves, there is an opportunity to deepen your ownership of Developer and self-serve product economics.</p> <p><strong>Role Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Build and maintain product cost models</strong> that translate compute, storage, bandwidth and AI / inference resource consumption into unit cost-to-serve, with transparent assumptions and documented methodologies.</li> <li><strong>Partner with Product and Engineering</strong> to evaluate new product introductions, architecture changes and shifts in resource usage; quantify cost and margin implications across connected workloads.</li> <li><strong>Develop and validate shared-cost allocation analyses</strong> with Infrastructure Finance and finance data partners, using relevant consumption and capacity drivers. Distinguish direct costs, shared costs and unused capacity, and reconcile product views to underlying financial totals.</li> <li><strong>Support Pricing with reliable cost inputs and scenario analysis</strong> for commercial decisions and quoting workflows. Translate changes in hardware generations, bandwidth rates and product architecture into updated assumptions.</li> <li><strong>Connect capital investment to product economics</strong> by analyzing server costs, deployment timing, useful-life and depreciation assumptions, utilization and capacity across edge, core and accelerated-computing infrastructure, in partnership with Infrastructure Finance and Accounting.</li> <li><strong>Contribute to capital and capacity planning</strong> through demand-versus-capacity scenarios, investment trade-offs and forecast updates. Explain how deployment timing and workload mix affect near-term costs and longer-term unit economics.</li> <li><strong>Produce decision-ready reporting</strong> on product costs, unit economics and relevant margin drivers. Explain actual-versus-plan changes and separate volume, mix, rate, utilization and allocation effects.</li> <li><strong>Improve finance data and repeatable workflows</strong> with finance programs, data and engineering partners. Help validate operational inputs, establish reconciliation checks, and automate recurring analyses to support more frequent forecasting and a faster, more reliable close.</li> <li><strong>Translate analysis into recommendations</strong> that technical and non-technical partners can act on, balancing detail, financial judgment and the needs of a growing product portfolio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Role Requirements</strong></p> <p><strong>Must-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>5+ Years experience in FP&A, strategic finance, cost analysis, business analytics or a related analytical field, with evidence of building financial models and translating data into business recommendations.</li> <li>Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to build flexible, driver-based models and test assumptions through sensitivity and scenario analysis.</li> <li>Ability to work with large or imperfect datasets, investigate discrepancies, reconcile financial and operational views, and document assumptions and controls.</li> <li>Understanding of financial statements, cost drivers, gross margin and unit economics, with familiarity with capital expenditures and depreciation.</li> <li>Ability to learn technical business models and connect resource usage, infrastructure capacity and product architecture to financial outcomes.</li> <li>Strong cross-functional collaboration and clear written and verbal communication; comfortable asking questions, challenging assumptions constructively and explaining analysis to different audiences.</li> <li>Evidence of ongoing AI skill development, including prompt and context engineering; ability to evaluate emerging tools and apply them to practical finance problems.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice-to-Have Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience with cloud infrastructure, developer platforms, usage-based businesses, product costing or shared-cost allocations.</li> <li>Hands-on SQL skills and experience with business intelligence tools; Python or another analytical scripting language for repeatable analysis.</li> <li>Familiarity with infrastructure and/or data-center operations and the financial drivers of capacity expansion, such as hardware, power, cooling and deployment lead times; exposure to construction or build-out economics is a plus.</li> <li>Exposure to server or network capital planning, hardware lifecycle economics, utilization analysis or fixed-asset reporting.</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools into finance or analytical workflows—such as data preparation, reconciliation, cost-model updates or variance analysis—with measurable improvements in cycle time, accuracy or review quality.</li> <li>Experience applying responsible AI practices to financial analysis, including assessing data-privacy and decision risks, checking for bias or misleading assumptions, validating outputs against source data, and maintaining human review and an auditable record.</li> <li>Experience improving financial systems, allocation title: Senior Commercial Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Available Locations</span></h2> <hr> <p>Switzerland</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">About the Role</span></h2> <hr> <p>We are seeking a highly accomplished and strategic Sr. Commercial Account Executive to join our <strong>Swiss Sales Team, specifically for the</strong> <strong>German speaking part of Switzerland</strong>. In this advanced role, you will be pivotal in driving significant growth by leading comprehensive sales cycles within a portfolio of assigned enterprise-level clients, and strategically acquiring new logos. The ideal candidate possesses a deep blend of advanced sales acumen and sophisticated technical understanding, enabling them to lead engagements at all levels, from the C-suite to technical leaders (e.g., Head of/VP of Networking or Security).</p> <p>As an Sr. Commercial Account Executive, you will consistently demonstrate advanced proficiency in all sales activities, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, proactive and strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales. You will be a key driver of digital transformation for our customers, understanding their broader market trends and how Cloudflare uniquely enables their strategic initiatives. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you will be expected to leverage AI tools actively in your daily workflow — from account research and outreach to meeting preparation and pipeline management — using them as a genuine productivity multiplier, not an afterthought.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>Strategic Revenue Generation:</strong> Architect and execute advanced territory and account plans to consistently exceed multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas, with a strong focus on new business acquisition and expansion within complex enterprise environments.</li> <li><strong>Expert Pipeline & Forecasting:</strong> Lead proactive and strategic pipeline management efforts, demonstrating a sophisticated understanding of sales cycles and customer buying processes. Deliver highly accurate forecasts, providing clear insights and strategic guidance to sales leadership.</li> <li><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you sell — applying them to account research, personalised outreach, executive meeting preparation, pipeline analysis, and follow-up drafting. Demonstrate the same AI-native mindset Cloudflare brings to its products in how you manage your own territory and time.</li> <li><strong>Deep Customer & IT Architecture Understanding:</strong> Develop a profound understanding of customers' IT architectures, including applications and third-party technologies. Architect and align Cloudflare Reference Architectures to customer environments, driving comprehensive platform solutions.</li> <li><strong>Multi-Engagement Leadership:</strong> Orchestrate and manage multiple complex customer engagements simultaneously across various business units within an organization. Strategically connect disparate needs to strengthen Cloudflare's platform sale, actively involving and influencing technical C-level minus one executives.</li> <li><strong>Virtual Team Leadership:</strong> Set clear direction and lead a virtual team of in-GEO specialists, Product Managers, Deal Desk, and Legal to collaboratively manage and close complex customer opportunities. Proactively identify and navigate through situations to address colleague and customer needs, escalating as appropriate to drive urgency and efficient delivery.</li> <li><strong>Digital Transformation Authority:</strong> Act as an authority on digital transformation, understanding key drivers (e.g., new offering development, enhanced customer capabilities) and the broader market trends influencing these decisions. Position Cloudflare as a critical enabler of these transformations.</li> <li><strong>Compelling Value Creation:</strong> Articulate highly compelling, strategic value propositions for Cloudflare's services, directly linking them to customer business outcomes and strategic objectives. Lead with a strong focus on the "why," communicating the whole picture to both internal and external stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Advanced Negotiation & Closure:</strong> Expertly lead and navigate complex contract negotiations, driving win-win scenarios for all parties. Demonstrate advanced closing skills across new business and expansion opportunities.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisor & Coach:</strong> Build long-term, executive-level strategic relationships, ensuring deep customer adoption, retention, and expansion. Consistently provide clear, direct, and constructive feedback to team members, coaching them to improve communication, learn from mistakes, and enhance the quality of work. Share learnings proactively to build trust across the organization.</li> <li><strong>Organizational Impact & Leadership:</strong> Consistently focus on the long-term needs of the team and the business, understanding how decisions impact other teams and openly sharing these insights. Leverage company-wide learnings to improve department and team execution. Serve as a leader within Cloudflare, making significant contributions while elevating the work of others by bringing diverse perspectives and strategic long-term thinking.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of advanced experience selling complex technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model</strong>, with a significant track record of consistently exceeding multi-million dollar quota targets.</li> <li><strong>Deep expertise and fluency in Cloud Networking, Security, and Edge Computing technologies</strong>, with an exceptional ability to articulate features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments (e.g., SMBs, enterprise, vertical markets).</li> <li><strong>Proven ability to deeply understand complex customer IT architectures</strong> and effectively map them to Cloudflare Reference Architectures for successful platform sales.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated success leading and influencing virtual cross-functional teams</strong> (e.g., Solution Engineers, Product Managers, Legal) to drive complex deals to closure.</li> <li><strong>Exceptional strategic communication and presentation skills</strong>, with a focus on articulating the "why" and conveying the whole picture to executive leadership and technical decision-makers (C-level minus one).</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated use of AI tools in a sales context</strong> — account intelligence, outreach personalisation, pipeline management, or meeting preparation. You can speak specifically to how AI has made you faster, sharper, or more effective in a previous role.</li> <li><strong>Advanced negotiation skills</strong> with a track record of closing large, complex, six-figure and multi-million dollar deals.</li> <li><strong>Expert-level sales acumen:</strong> unparalleled proficiency in discovery, positioning, competitive selling, negotiation, closing, and expansion strategies within enterprise accounts.</li> <li><strong>Authority on digital transformation trends</strong> and their impact on enterprise customers, with the ability to position Cloudflare as a key enabler of strategic business outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Strong coaching and mentorship abilities</strong>, with a passion for helping colleagues grow and improve.</li> <li><strong>Highly self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and resilient</strong>, thriving in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a consistent focus on long-term goals.</li> <li><strong>Proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms</strong> (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC framework application).</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree required</strong>, with a technical background (e.g., engineering, computer science, MIS) highly preferred.</li> <li><strong>Ability to travel</strong> as required to engage with key customers and internal teams.</li> <li><strong>Language Skills: German OR French & English</strong></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. experience.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What you will need:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Advanced Go Engineering:</strong> Extensive experience building and scaling Go services in high-traffic, high-volume SaaS environments.</li> <li><strong>Distributed Systems Mastery:</strong> Proven ability to design microservices that utilize asynchronous processing (Kafka & SQS) and low-latency communication (gRPC/ConnectRPC/GraphQL).</li> <li><strong>Cloud Architecture:</strong> Deep knowledge of AWS (EKS, S3, Lambda) and experience managing complex compute environments.</li> <li><strong>Product Rigor:</strong> A background in building professional-grade creative tools or media-heavy applications.</li> <li><strong>Software Best Practices:</strong> A quality-first mindset description: Was bluu bewegt Wir bei bluu verändern, wie Menschen ihren Haushalt machen. Unsere Produkte, zum Beispiel unsere Waschstreifen, machen Waschen und Putzen leichter. Warum funktioniert ein Creative diese Woche und nächste Woche nicht mehr? Und wie wird aus einem Like eine Bestellung, in der Schweiz und bald auch in Europa? Genau dafür suchen wir dich. Wir holen Content und Creative gerade ins Haus. Meta läuft seit August bei uns statt bei einer Agentur. Jetzt suchen wir eine Person, die Verantwortung übernimmt: für unseren Content, für unsere organischen Kanäle und dafür, dass bluu in der Schweiz und in Europa sichtbar wird und wächst. title: ML Intern: Optimization Quality & Monitoring
description: Our common vision Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Our AI-powered attribution creates real transparency, showing how digital advertising investments perform across channels. On that foundation, we optimize budgets so our customers can sustainably grow their bottom line. We support leading European brands across e-commerce, telco, banking, insurance & energy, and many other industries in making their marketing smarter, more efficient, and more impactful. About the role Nexoya runs fully automated, AI-driven budget optimizations and simulations for enterprise marketing portfolios across many ad channels. Every result that reaches a customer must be correct, explainable and on time. As our ML Intern, you make sure it is: you monitor pipeline health, check the quality of predictions, optimizations and simulations, investigate anomalies and turn recurring manual checks into reliable tooling. You work closely with our ML engineers and Customer Success, and you see directly how your work shapes our customers' budget decisions. Your responsibilities Monitor the automation and assure result quality Monitor the automated prediction, optimization and simulation pipelines across customer portfolios and track run health, completeness and timeliness. Verify that predictions, optimization proposals and simulation results meet our quality standards before they reach customers: budget shifts, expected KPI changes, channel constraints and funnel-level effects. Investigate failed or unexpected runs, identify the root cause (data, configuration or model) and resolve it or escalate it with a clear diagnosis. Assure the quality of results over time Define and maintain plausibility checks for optimization and simulation results, for example for budget planning, seasonal shifts or new channel tests. Make sure results are consistent and explainable, so that customers and account managers can trust them without manual checks. Compare optimized and simulated outcomes with realized performance, document deviations and feed the findings back to the ML team. Safeguard data and model quality Monitor input data for gaps, anomalies and tracking changes that affect optimization quality. Track model fit and prediction accuracy per portfolio and flag degradation early. Maintain portfolio configurations such as funnel steps, constraints and target definitions together with the responsible teams. Automate the operational workflow Replace manual checks with Python scripts, validation rules and alerts. Build and maintain dashboards that show run status, data health and model performance across portfolios. Write runbooks so that operational knowledge is shared, not held by one person. The impact you will have Customers receive optimization proposals and simulations that are correct and delivered on time. Issues are caught before customers see them, not after. The time the ML team spends on operational work goes down measurably, because recurring steps are automated. Customer Success can trust automated optimization and simulation results without checking them by hand. Your experience and skills Recently completed Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering or a related field. Solid Python skills, including pandas and NumPy, and comfort working with SQL. Good understanding of statistics and basic machine learning concepts such as regression, model evaluation and overfitting. A careful, structured way of working: you check results before you share them and you document what you do. Ability to explain technical findings clearly to non-technical colleagues. Fluent English, spoken and written, is a must. Bonus points Experience with optimization methods, for example constrained or non-convex optimization. Familiarity with Marketing Mix Modeling, attribution or digital advertising metrics. Experience with data pipelines, scheduled jobs or monitoring tools. Experience with Git, Docker and cloud environments. Fluent in German or Italian. Your future work life Purpose: Your work directly influences how enterprise marketers allocate their budgets. Responsibility: You own the quality of a defined part of our automation from day one, with a personal development roadmap and regular feedback. Learning: You work alongside experienced ML and data engineers on production systems, not on side projects. Culture: A transparent company culture at eye level, where every person is valued and supported. Strategy: You take part in shaping company strategy and culture during our quarterly Strategy Days. Events: Regular team events, on-site and off-site. Application process Profile review and short phone screen Take-home case study Case discussion with the ML team On-site interview and team evaluation Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP Media</strong></p> <p>WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. </p> <p>WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.</p> <p>For more information, visit <a href="wppmedia.com">wppmedia.com</a>.</p></div><h2><strong>Das bieten wir dir:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Work-life-balance</strong>: Für uns steht Teamarbeit und der persönliche Austausch im Büro im Vordergrund. Du steuerst Kundenprojekte und Kampagnen über alle relevanten Offline-Mediakanäle hinweg, behältst Budgets und Marktbewegungen im Blick und bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden sowie interne Teams.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Marken- & Kommunikationsstrategie:</strong> Entwicklung von Markenstrategien und Ableitung passender Media- und Kommunikationsstrategien.</li> <li><strong>Kampagnensteuerung & Digitalintegration:</strong> Planung, Umsetzung, Analyse und Optimierung von Kampagnen über alle Offline-Mediakanäle hinweg sowie ganzheitliche Integration digitaler Kanäle in die Mediaaktivierungen.</li> <li><strong>Kundenberatung & Budgetverantwortung:</strong> Zentrale Ansprechperson für alle mediarelevanten Kundenfragen sowie Verwaltung und Forecasting der Kundenbudgets.</li> <li><strong>Projekt- & Prozessmanagement:</strong> Koordination aller Kundenprojekte und klare Priorisierung der Aufgaben im Team in enger Abstimmung mit dem Director; außerdem Unterstützung des Line-Managers und Zusammenarbeit mit Spezialunits.</li> <li><strong>Teamführung & Aktivierungskoordination:</strong> Selbstständige Steuerung deiner Aufgaben sowie fachliche Begleitung und Ausbildung von Junior-Kolleg:innen. Du koordinierst und briefst interne Aktivierungsabteilungen.</li> <li><strong>Markt- & Partnermanagement:</strong> Verantwortung für das Setup und Handling externer Dienstleistungen und Marktteilnehmender, Beobachtung des Wettbewerbs sowie Identifikation von Wachstumsmöglichkeiten und Unterstützung interner Projekte.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Das zeichnet dich aus:</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Mediaerfahrung:</strong> Berufserfahrung in der Mediaberatung und/oder Mediaplanung, idealerweise in einer Mediaagentur.</li> <li><strong>Strategisches Media-Know-how:</strong> Verständnis für Marken-, Media- und Kommunikationsstrategien sowie Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung von Kampagnen über verschiedene Medienkanäle.</li> <li><strong>Kundenberatung & Kommunikation:</strong> Souveränes, kommunikatives Auftreten und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge zielgruppengerecht und verständlich zu vermitteln.</li> <li><strong>Organisation & Qualität:</strong> Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und qualitative Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, mehrere Projekte und Aufgaben zu koordinieren.</li> <li><strong>Verantwortung & Teamgeist:</strong> Selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit sowie daran, Junior-Kolleg:innen zu unterstützen und weiterzuentwickeln.</li> <li><strong>Sprachkenntnisse:</strong> Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.</li> </ul> <p>Darüber hinaus bist du: <strong>#client-partner #media-strategist #team-player</strong></p> <p>Wenn du diesen Job spannend findest, dann ermutigen wir dich ausdrücklich zur Bewerbung, auch wenn du nicht jede oben gelistete Qualifikation aufweisen kannst.</p> <p> </p> <h2><strong>Arbeiten bei WPP Media:</strong></h2> <p>Als WPP Media gestalten wir die Zukunft der Medien und investieren dabei konsequent in unsere Mitarbeiter:innen. Jede:r Kolleg:in genießt die Vorteile des globalen Netzwerks von WPP Media und WPP, um sich weiterzuentwickeln und an der Spitze von Marketing und Werbung zu lernen. Vielfalt und Zusammenhalt leben wir durch zahlreiche Employee Resource Groups und regelmäßige interne Events - zum Austausch, zur Inspiration und zum gemeinsamen Feiern unserer Erfolge.<br> <br>WPP Media ist ein Arbeitgeber, der Chancengleichheit fördert. Wir berücksichtigen alle Bewerber:innen für alle Positionen ohne Diskriminierung. Unser Ziel ist eine Kultur des Respekts und der Zugehörigkeit, in der jede:r die gleichen Möglichkeiten hat, sich einzubringen und beruflich zu wachsen.</p> <p>Bitte lies unsere <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">Datenschutzerklärung</a> für Deutschland, Österreich und die Schweiz, um weitere Informationen darüber zu erhalten, wie wir die von dir bereitgestellten Daten verarbeiten. #LI-Promoted 13731</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"> <span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335559739":0,"335559740":276}"> </span></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Robot Pilot
description: About nu glass The Robot Pilot is responsible for operating our laser robot technology on-site, ensuring strict adherence to production schedules, quality standards, and safety guidelines. Reporting to the Robotics Manufacturing and Support Engineer, this role plays a key part in troubleshooting issues and maintaining efficient, continuous operations within a collaborative team. Your responsibilities As a Robot Pilot at nu glass in Spiez, you will operate and manage robotic systems directly on-site as part of a 45-hour workweek on a 12-month fixed-term contract starting January 11, 2027. Responsibilities & Areas of Expertise - Machine Operation & Daily Maintenance: Operating and running the laser robot (CNC) at the assigned site; systematically performing Level 1 maintenance, including daily cleaning, thorough cleaning of protective glass panels, and verification of safety barriers before starting each shift. - Quality Control & Production Monitoring: Conducting visual inspections and quality checks; accurately recording production tracking sheets, scrap rates, and performance data (KPIs) in Odoo. - Safety & Site Discipline (5S Methodology): Strictly complying with EHS/OHS requirements, personal protective equipment (PPE) standards, and ergonomic guidelines; maintaining a consistently clean, tidy, and well-organized 5S-compliant workstation at the client site. - Escalation & First-Level Troubleshooting: Early detection of technical deviations; promptly notifying the Production Manager and Technical Support (Olivier); assisting with the initial diagnosis of straightforward technical issues. - On-Site Presence & Operational Continuity: Ensuring production continuity at the assigned site and participating in shift handovers between teams, as well as during Technical Support interventions. What we are looking for We are looking for someone ready to take on the operation of our specialized laser ablation equipment within our agile team. Open to working 4 nights/week German and English speaker Willing to travel in Germany and within Switzerland ( at our cost) Your first months at nu glass You will quickly get hands-on with state-of-the-art laser technology, integrating into our daily operations and contributing to projects that enhance connectivity and sustainability. If you match most of our requirements, we encourage you to apply. Benefits Flexible working hours Compensation CHF 60,000–64,800 per year Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: People Operations Specialist, Singapore (6 Month Contract)
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Location: Singapore</strong></p> <p><strong>What You Would Do Here:</strong></p> <p>Our focus is getting the best people to work at Cloudflare and then allowing them to do their best work. We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented People Operations Specialist to join our team and champion this mission within the APJC region. In this vital role, you will be the first point of contact for our employees, ensuring their journey is smooth and positive. You will be instrumental in creating a seamless experience by resolving inquiries, managing data with precision, and ensuring our People processes are efficient and effective. This is an exciting opportunity to provide exceptional support to our internal teams and contribute to building a world-class employee experience as our organization expands.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Champion key employee lifecycle process:</strong> Take ownership of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes across APJC, including onboarding, internal transfers, organizational changes, and offboarding, ensuring a smooth, consistent, and positive experience for employees throughout the APJC region.</li> <li><strong>Be a subject-matter expert for employee inquiries:</strong> Provide timely, high-quality support to employee inquiries through Zendesk. title: Entrepreneur Intern
description: About SeeSicht Gmbh SeeSicht is a small family office of AI-first companies. We build companies that are profitable today and keep them for the long term — not a venture builder chasing funding rounds. Every project is funded 100% by me or by me and my network. No investor search, no fundraising rounds. Your first months at SeeSicht Gmbh You will take on core business development tasks, working alongside experienced team members to support company initiatives. Through daily operations, you will learn how the business scales and manage assigned projects within a hybrid work environment. What you will do You execute. I bring the ideas, the network and the money — you turn them into real products, pages, campaigns and processes. You build and test the way we always do it: build a sellable prototype (CHF 100–1,000), test it on the market with Facebook ads (CHF 5,000–10,000), build the product fully (CHF 10,000–20,000), then launch with real marketing spend. MyBikePlan is the proof: 2019 idea, one-week website, one week of Facebook marketing, CHF 500 invested → 30 pre-orders. 2020 launch with CHF 1M in the first year, 2021 team, 2025 sold close to CHF 20M. The playbook is set — you run it on new projects. Current projects: Fairbroker.ch (AI insurance broker, market test now, live Q1 2027), a kettlebell workout app (52-card deck, early prototype, suppliers in China secured), and Glanzio (B2B store-window cleaning, launch test Q1 2027). The timeline — how it works Months 1–12 — the internship: CHF 2,500/month, full-time, paid, and inside that year up to 10% of the profit of the project/company you work on. From month 13 — the stake: the internship is over and you get a stake in the company, up to 10% equity, with a base salary of at least CHF 5,000/month — plus the up to 10% profit share on top. If a project becomes a real company, a senior position is possible, depending on how you develop. What you get from day 1 All the AI tools A company laptop A place to work and a structure from day 1 Me, coaching and strategising side by side with you Who we're looking for (requirements) You're finishing or just finished university. Two of these skills are genuinely strong, the rest you understand and want to grow: marketing, operations/service design, design, UX, AI usage. You work the way we work: Lovable, Claude and Airtable — that's the whole stack. If something is missing, you say why and it gets added. You're transparent, fast and smart. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. In this role, you'll help extend that footprint with a new generation of data center sites across the United States.</p> <h3>About the Role</h3> <p>We're looking for an experienced Data Center Operations manager to build and run the team that brings these new sites online and keeps them running around the clock.</p> <p>You will build a distributed team of Data Center Engineers from the ground up. skill</strong>: fluency with modern AI tooling and a track record of using it to amplify your impact.</li> <li><strong>Sound judgment with confidential information</strong>, including awareness of public markets.</li> </ul> </li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li><span data-sheets-root="1">For Bay Area You own it through execution.</p> <h3>What you get to do in this role:</h3> <ul> <li>Build and run a pipeline of MW-scale sites: developers, landlords, wholesale operators, power developers, utilities</li> <li>Lead technical diligence: power availability and energization, electrical topology and redundancy, rack density and cooling (including liquid), fiber diversity, PUE, geotech, permitting, commissioning evidence, network latency</li> <li>Run the deal from long list through RFP, site visit, LOI, lease or powered-shell, work letter, and signature (campuses, dedicated buildings, dedicated halls, core expansions, BTS)</li> <li>Negotiate NNN / triple-net and the structures next to it (modified gross, FRI, wholesale dedicated-room, powered shell, BTS, sale-leaseback, JV): $/kW-month, NRC/MRC, escalators, PUE, delay credits, SLAs, ramp, expansion rights, ROFR, exit and renewal</li> <li>Keep landlord scope and Cloudflare scope explicit, including power to dedicated PDU and tenant fit-out</li> <li>Build the TCO / cost-per-MW / NPV case and take the capital ask to leadership</li> <li>Work with legal, operations, capacity planning, network strategy, energy, and security on requirements and delivery dates</li> <li>Run QBRs with campus landlords. This critical role is part of the Infrastructure Operations organization, which is responsible for building, scaling, and running Cloudflare's data center and network infrastructure across 700+ sites worldwide.</p> <p>The DCSC team manages physical access control and compliance auditing across one of the most complex and distributed infrastructure footprints in the industry, spanning more than 105 vendor portals, hundreds of non-portal carrier-neutral and edge partner sites, and multiple regulatory frameworks including SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP. The operational burden of this work is substantial and largely manual: user lists are pulled by hand, access control lists are reconciled by eye, evidence packages are assembled ticket by ticket, and attestation cycles consume weeks of coordinator time every quarter.</p> <p>This role exists to change that. The DCSC Automation -Specialist will design, build, and operate AI-assisted and automated workflows that eliminate the most time-consuming manual work in the DCSC operating model, freeing compliance coordinators to focus on exception handling, stakeholder relationships, and regulatory judgment rather than data gathering and reconciliation.</p> <p>This is a builder role. You will interview the team to understand each workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation targets, and ship tooling that demonstrably reduces the time it takes to close a QAR cycle, produce an audit evidence package, or manage a batch of access provisioning requests. You will work in close partnership with the DCSC coordinators, and existing automation developers, and will own the DCSC operational tooling roadmap.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li><strong> Portal Automation & User List Extraction</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Browser Automation: Design and maintain automated scripts (Playwright, Puppeteer, or equivalent) that log into vendor data center portals, extract user access lists, and feed structured output into the DCSC Portal and comparison pipelines replacing manual portal-by-portal data collection across 105+ portals covering 338+ sites.</li> <li>Resilience & Coverage: Build fallback handling for portals that block or rate-limit automated access; document exceptions and maintain a coverage registry tracking automation status per portal.</li> <li>Scheduled Execution: Operationalize extraction jobs on a recurring cadence aligned to QAR and MAR cycles, with alerting for failures and drift.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> ACL Reconciliation & Diff Engine</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Automated Comparison: Build tooling that ingests portal-extracted user lists and compares them against the master Access Control List (ACL), automatically surfacing discrepancies: users present in a portal but absent from the ACL, users on the ACL without active portal access, and role or access-level mismatches.</li> <li>Exception-Only Output: Route confirmed discrepancies directly to pre-populated Jira tickets for human review and action, eliminating the need for coordinators to perform full manual review of every user record each quarter.</li> <li>Audit Trail: Ensure all comparison runs produce immutable, timestamped records suitable for SOC 2, ISO 27001, and FedRAMP evidence requirements.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> Attestation & Evidence Automation</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Attestation Module: Own and extend the attestation workflow within the DCSC Portal, including automated cycle triggering, manager notification, time-stamped confirmation capture, and exception escalation, replacing manual screenshot-based evidence gathering.</li> <li>Evidence Package Builder: Build automated pipelines that compile audit-ready evidence packages for SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, ISMAP, and IRAP control cycles, pulling attestation logs, portal extraction results, diff reports, and correspondence into structured packages keyed to specific control IDs.</li> <li>GRC Alignment: Work directly with GRC counterparts to validate that automated evidence formats meet auditor and regulatory requirements before deployment.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> AI-Assisted Anomaly Detection & Triage</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Access Pattern Analysis: Implement LLM-based review passes over QAR cycle output to surface patterns warranting human escalation: former employees retaining access, access creep over time, dormant accounts, and anomalous role assignments across sites.</li> <li>Ticket Intelligence: Build automation that reads incoming Jira onboarding and offboarding tickets and generates structured, portal-specific action checklists reducing coordinator cognitive load and preventing missed steps across multi-portal provisioning workflows.</li> <li>Continuous Improvement: Monitor automation output quality over time, retrain or recalibrate models as portal structures change, and maintain a feedback loop with coordinators on false positives and missed detections.</li> </ul> <ol> <li><strong> DCSC Portal Ownership & Tooling Roadmap</strong></li> </ol> <ul> <li>Platform Stewardship: Own the DCSC Portal as the operational runtime for all automation and workflow tooling ensuring it remains stable, documented, and usable by coordinators without engineering support for day-to-day tasks.</li> <li>Roadmap Management: Maintain a prioritized backlog of automation opportunities, assessed by time savings, compliance impact, and implementation complexity; present quarterly progress and priorities to DCSC leadership.</li> <li>Documentation: Produce runbooks for every automation, ensuring that no operational capability lives only in one person's head or on a local machine.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable skills / Experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Automation Engineering: Demonstrated experience building browser automation (Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium, or equivalent) against real-world web applications, including handling authentication flows, dynamic content, and anti-bot mitigations.</li> <li>TypeScript Proficiency: Strong skills for scripting, data wrangling, structured file I/O, and API integration. Ability to write maintainable, documented code that non-engineers can operate.</li> <li>LLM Integration: Hands-on experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, or equivalent) into production workflows for classification, drafting, summarization, or anomaly detection tasks.</li> <li>Data Engineering Fundamentals: Comfort working with structured and semi-structured data at scale, diffing datasets, normalizing inconsistent formats, and producing clean outputs for downstream audit use.</li> <li>API & Workflow Integration: Experience building integrations with ticketing or ITSM systems (Jira preferred) via REST API, including automated ticket creation, status updates, and attachment handling.</li> <li>Systems Thinking: Ability to map an end-to-end manual workflow, identify the highest-leverage automation insertion points, and ship incrementally without waiting for a perfect solution.</li> <li>Workflow Archaeology: Comfortable extracting process knowledge from subject-matter experts through structured interviews turning tribal knowledge into documented, automatable workflows.</li> <li>Bias Toward Simplicity: Strong product intuition for the minimum viable automation that delivers real time savings, rather than over-engineering for edge cases.</li> <li>Compliance Awareness: Appreciation for the stakes of accuracy in a compliance context, understanding that an incorrect ACL diff or a missing evidence artifact has real audit consequences.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Soft Skills:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Communication: Able to explain automation design decisions and tradeoffs clearly to non-technical stakeholders including compliance coordinators and GRC partners.</li> <li>Ambiguity Tolerance: Vendor portals don't come with documentation. Workflows are passed down verbally. You need to be energized by figuring things out from scratch.</li> <li>Preferred Qualifications</li> <li>Experience with Cloudflare Workers or similar edge compute platforms</li> <li>Familiarity with GRC/compliance frameworks (SOC 2, FedRAMP, ISO 27001) at an operational level — not as an auditor, but enough to understand why evidence integrity matters</li> <li>RPA tooling experience (UiPath, Power Automate) as fallback for portals that defeat headless browsers</li> <li>Prior work in infrastructure operations, data center, or physical security environments</li> <li>Experience building internal tooling or developer-facing portals (not just scripts)</li> </ul> <p></p> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1

title: Developer GTM Strategy Manager, Technical Programs

Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. This role is focused on the technical side of that motion: where we should spend time, how we coordinate technical resources, how we run customer-facing programs, and how we measure whether technical work is driving the right business outcomes.</p> <p>The right person is a high-agency operator with strong technical fluency. They do not need to be a Solutions Architect, but they should be comfortable working with technical products, customer architectures, implementation workflows, developer platforms, and customer-facing technical teams.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Build and scale technical programs: </strong>Design proactive programs for Solutions Architects, Forward Deployed Engineers, and related technical GTM teams. Services packaging and commercialization: </strong>Partner with Professional Services, Finance, Product, Sales Strategy, and GTM leaders on pricing, packaging, business cases, rollout plans, and feedback loops for technical services offerings.</li> <li><strong>Incubate and launch new technical programs:</strong> Lead high-priority projects across Developer GTM, support team planning and process improvements, turn technical activity into clear business narratives, and incubate new motions until they are measurable and ready for durable ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of projects this person may own</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a proactive SA/FDE engagement program for a priority customer segment or product motion.</li> <li>Partner on an account propensity model that for rollout.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Success Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li>Solutions Architects and FDEs have a clearer operating model for proactive programs and strategic customer engagements.</li> <li>Leadership has a reliable view of technical revenue pipeline, engagement health, account propensity, and investment ROI.</li> <li>Strategic customer initiatives and technical onsite visits move faster because goals, staffing, owners, success criteria, and follow-up are clear.</li> <li>Professional Services offerings are easier to understand, price, package, and align to Cloudflare's broader consumption-led strategy.</li> <li>New technical GTM motions move from ambiguous ideas to measurable programs with durable owners.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <p><em><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates come from diverse backgrounds with non-linear paths. You don’t need to tick every single box to be right for this role. If you are excited about building a better Internet and ready to make an impact, please apply.</span></em></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience in GTM strategy, business operations, revenue operations, technical program management, solutions strategy, consulting, or a similar cross-functional execution role.</li> <li>Experience working with technical customer-facing teams such as Solutions Architects, Sales Engineers, Forward Deployed Engineers, Professional Services, Customer Engineering, Developer Relations, or Product.</li> <li>Strong technical fluency, including the ability to understand customer architecture discussions, implementation tradeoffs, developer platform concepts, and the operating needs of technical GTM teams.</li> <li>Strong program management ability, including managing complex work streams, driving accountability without direct authority, and keeping teams aligned under pressure.</li> <li>Strong sense of ownership; someone who takes initiative, works independently, and manages time effectively.</li> <li>Excellent cross-functional communication skills and the ability to influence and align stakeholders at all levels.</li> <li>Highly customer-centric, with natural curiosity about technical products and a strategic mindset for solving complex problems.</li> <li>Comfortable working under pressure and adjusting priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-moving environment.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills, including comfort using spreadsheets, CRM data, and business dashboards to prioritize work and inform decisions.</li> <li>Prior experience with Salesforce CRM, Tableau, BigQuery, or BoostUp is a plus.</li> <li>Background in SaaS or Product-Led Growth (PLG) is a strong plus.</li> <li> </li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For Bay Area based hires: Estimated annual salary of $161,000 - In this high-energy, hunter role, your primary mission is new logo acquisition — finding, engaging, and closing net-new digital-native companies across the region who are not yet working with Cloudflare. Your target universe includes fintechs, SaaS platforms, AI-native startups, developer-led scale-ups, and cloud-first businesses: companies that move fast, make infrastructure decisions at the engineering level, and expect their vendors to keep up. The ideal candidate understands how digital-native companies actually buy — bottom-up product adoption, engineering influence, founder-driven decisions, and rapid procurement — and engages as a credible peer in conversations with CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and technical founders.</p> <p class="doc-paragraph">As a Digital Natives Account Executive, you will build pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, and ecosystem presence, convert developer-led adoption into commercial new logo wins, and position Cloudflare as the infrastructure partner of choice for the next generation of technology companies. Critically, you will use AI tools as an active and integral part of how you sell — both because your buyers, who are often building AI products themselves, will notice and respect it, and because winning new logos at pace in this segment requires it. In line with Cloudflare's AI-native culture, you are expected to leverage AI tools daily as a genuine force multiplier across your prospecting, pipeline, and preparation — not as an occasional aid.</p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Responsibilities</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li><strong>New Logo Acquisition:</strong> Drive the identification, pursuit, and closure of net-new digital-native accounts as the primary focus of this role. Build pipeline through outbound prospecting, community engagement, VC and accelerator networks, partner channels, and product-led adoption signals. Consistently bring new customers onto the Cloudflare platform and exceed new logo targets each quarter.</li> <li><strong>Outbound & Ecosystem-Led Pipeline Generation: </strong>Take full ownership of pipeline creation — through direct outreach, active participation in the startup and tech ecosystem, and engagement with founder and developer communities across DACH. Identify buying signals early and move quickly to engage the right stakeholders at the right moment.</li> <li><strong>Developer & Technical Buyer Engagement:</strong> Build credible, trusted relationships with technically sophisticated buyers — CTOs, VPs of Engineering, platform leads, and technical founders. Engage with genuine fluency on infrastructure, APIs, developer experience, cloud architecture, and security — translating Cloudflare's capabilities into outcomes that matter to people who build things.</li> <li><strong>Product-Led Growth Conversion: </strong>Identify accounts where individual or team-level usage of Cloudflare's platform signals a commercial opportunity. Convert that adoption into formalised new logo wins by engaging the right stakeholders with the right narrative at the right time, before a competitor does.</li> <li><strong>AI Platform Positioning: </strong>Position Cloudflare's AI infrastructure capabilities — AI Gateway, Workers AI, Vectorize, and Zero Trust for AI workloads — to prospects building AI-powered products and services. Understand the real challenges your customers face around securing AI APIs, managing inference at scale, and controlling AI infrastructure costs, and articulate how Cloudflare addresses them in a way that resonates with technical buyers.</li> <li><strong>AI-Powered Sales Execution:</strong> Leverage AI tools as a deliberate and consistent part of how you prospect and sell — applying them to target account research, personalised outreach at scale, technical meeting preparation, pipeline management, and follow-up drafting. Your buyers are often building AI products; your workflow should reflect the same standard. Demonstrated AI fluency is a genuine expectation of this role, and you will be asked to speak specifically to how you use AI to improve your performance.</li> <li><strong>Full-Cycle Sales Management:</strong> Run efficient, full-cycle sales processes across a diverse prospect portfolio with varying deal sizes and cycle lengths. Qualify rigorously, engage the right stakeholders, apply appropriate urgency, and close new logo deals with confidence — whether the cycle takes two weeks or six months.</li> <li>Compelling Value Creation: Articulate clear, outcome-linked value propositions for Cloudflare's platform, tailored to the specific context and priorities of each prospect. Lead with the "why," communicating the full picture to both technical and commercial stakeholders at every stage of the sales cycle.</li> <li><strong>Post-Close Positioning: </strong>Ensure newly closed customers are set up for success on the Cloudflare platform and positioned for long-term growth. Identify early expansion signals and hand off cleanly — then focus on the next new logo.</li> <li><strong>Pipeline Management & Forecasting: </strong>Maintain a healthy, accurate new logo pipeline and deliver reliable, insight-driven forecast calls to sales leadership. Use AI-powered pipeline intelligence tools to keep your view of the business current, honest, and actionable.</li> <li><strong>Market Insight & Team Contribution:</strong> Share field intelligence from the digital-native ecosystem openly with the wider team. Contribute to Cloudflare's understanding of how this segment builds, buys, and scales — and help the organisation stay relevant and competitive in a fast-moving market.</li> </ul> <h2><span style="color: rgb(230, 126, 35);">Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</span></h2> <hr> <ul> <li>3–5 years of experience in B2B technology sales, with a consistent track record of meeting or exceeding new logo and quota targets, ideally selling to digital-native, developer-led, startup, or scale-up companies.</li> <li>Proven hunter mentality in a digital-native or startup context — you know how to find the right companies, get in front of the right people, and close before the window closes. You build your own pipeline and do not wait for inbound.</li> <li>Strong understanding of how digital-native companies buy — product-led growth, bottom-up adoption, engineering influence, founder decision-making, and fast-moving procurement cycles. provide actionable insights to the CFO, CEO, and Board of Directors.</li> <li>Build and maintain the internal analytical infrastructure that powers the function — the models, dashboards, trackers, and validation systems that let a small team operate at scale.</li> <li>Drive the IR function's use of AI-native tooling and automation, treating modern tools as a force multiplier on insight, productivity, accuracy, and stakeholder communications.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience</strong></h4> <p>To succeed in this role, you should be a strategic thinker with deep financial acumen, exceptional written and verbal communication skills, an ownership mindset, and a genuine intellectual curiosity about both the business and the public markets. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: London or Lisbon</strong></p> <h2>About the Department</h2> <p>Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>We build the infrastructure that makes the web <strong>Payable</strong>, powering the future of machine-to-machine commerce.</p> <p>Here at Cloudflare, agentic commerce is a core part of our vision for the <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/the-agentic-internet/">Agentic Internet</a>. As AI agents increasingly navigate, consume, and act on the web, standard payment and authorization models built for humans are breaking down. We are building tools that help make the new internet <strong>payable</strong> by giving our users the ability to take control over how AI agents pay for resources across the Internet.</p> <p>Building these capabilities requires solving problems across high-throughput web infrastructure, low-latency transaction processing, digital wallets, and emerging agentic payment protocols. We bridge mainstream fiat commerce rails with decentralized protocols, enabling micro-payments at Internet scale. We’re looking for someone excited to deliver products so domain owners can control this experience, while identifying the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <h2>About the role</h2> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to build and lead the engineering team across Agentic Commerce.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that power machine-to-machine payments and monetization, such as our <a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/monetization-gateway/">Monetization Gateway</a>. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. You will be a subject matter expert, speaking fluently about Cloudflare's products, features, benefits, and use cases across diverse customer segments. This role demands the ability to deeply understand complex customer IT Architectures, match them with relevant Cloudflare Reference Architectures, and orchestrate successful, large-scale platform sales.
